Subject (in full) People's Spiritual Mobilization Movement - French Concession Chinese Ratepayers' Association demands return of national flags

Made by/ ........................................ and ........................................ Forwarded by D.I. Crawford

During the morning of April 24, Mr. Koh Soh-liang (谷叔良) of the French Concession Chinese Ratepayers' Association called at the Political Section of the French Police in an endeavour to recover the National flags taken away by the police on the occasion of the propaganda day of the People's Spiritual Mobilization Movement. He was told that the flags would be handed over to the association after instructions have been received from the French Consular Authorities.

Visits were subsequently made by another representative of the Association to the French Consulate, when he was informed that the procedure for the return of the flags had not yet been completed.

That is, almost all the Chinese shop assistants and others involved in brawls with units of French Municipal Police on Wednesday have now been released, excepting those whom the French Municipal Police authorities consider as "agitators," who are still being held in custody.

According to the arrangements made with the French Police on Wednesday following negotiations, the Chinese Ratepayers' Association of the French Concession yesterday addressed a written request to the French Consul-General, M. Baudez, urging that the flags that have been seized by the French Police be restored to their rightful Chinese owners at an early date.

43 Chinese Arrested

According to a Chinese report, a total of 43 Chinese had been arrested by the French Municipal Police on Wednesday, and that a few of them had received injuries during the scuffles with the police units, and are now receiving medical treatment in various hospitals.

On Thursday night, the various local Chinese trade guilds were reported to have held an emergency meeting, following which it was decided to wire the Chungking Chinese Government to make representations to M. Henri Cosme, the French Ambassador to China.

A separate meeting was reported to have been held by the Chinese shop owners in the French Concession the same evening, after which it was also decided to wire the Chinese Central Government authorities, and to urge that negotiations be started with the competent French authorities in order that the freedom of the Concession Chinese to hoist their national emblems on appropriate occasions may be safeguarded.

Theatre Closed

The matinees and night performances of the Crystal Theatre, located at the corner of Rue du Consulat and Boulevard de Montigny were still being temporarily suspended yesterday as the French municipal permit has not been returned to the management since it was taken away last Wednesday.

A fight between some Chinese and a unit of French police took place outside the theatre premises on the day in question. The Chinese flag hoisted in front of the theatre was ordered to be taken down. This was complied with by the management, but no sooner had the emblem been lowered, than several telephone calls from unknown Chinese threatened the manager of the theatre with reprisals of one kind or another, and charged him with a lack of patriotism. Fearing the consequences, the management again caused the flag to be hoisted up in position. This resulted in the performance permit being withdrawn by the French authorities.

In spite of a general relaxation of the tension in the French Concession yesterday, following the resumption of usual business by all Chinese shops, units of the French police remained posted along the principal streets and intersections of busy thoroughfares as a precautionary measure, but fortunately, no untoward incident occurred.

The Settlement police authorities also took similar precautionary measures throughout the day, but no unpleasant incident was reported to have occurred.

租界“国旗事件”
被认为已结案

法捕与华人社团达成谅解；部分被捕者获释，仅扣留煽动分子

据悉，法租界因法市政警察禁止华人在周三庆祝“国民精神总动员”周期间悬挂中国国徽而引发的“国旗事件”，随着法市政警察（F. M. P.）与法租界华人纳税会之间达成友好和解，现被视为已结案。

昨日，所有华商店铺重新开门照常营业。此前，市商会曾敦促他们这样做，并指示所有本地华商恢复正常的商业活动，同时此事将由重庆外交部通过正常外交渠道与法国当局交涉。

据华人圈子昨日报道，继周三中国商人代表团向法捕当局提出交涉后，后者已作出让步。也就是说，除了被法市政警察当局视为“煽动者”并被继续拘留的人外，几乎所有在周三与法市政警察分队发生斗殴的中国店员及其他涉案人员现已获释。

根据周三谈判后与法捕达成的安排，法租界华人纳税会于昨日向法国总领事鲍德斯先生（M. Baudez）提交书面请求，敦促尽早将被法捕没收的旗帜归还原主。

43名中国人被捕

据中文报道，周三共有43名中国人被法市政警察逮捕，其中几人在与警察分队的冲突中受伤，目前正在各家医院接受治疗。

据报道，周四晚，当地各华人同业公会召开紧急会议，会后决定致电重庆中国政府，向法国驻华大使亨利·科斯梅先生（M. Henri Cosme）提出交涉。

据报道，当晚法租界内的中国店主也另行召开会议，会后同样决定致电中国中央政府当局，并敦促与法国主管当局开始谈判，以便保障租界华人在适当场合悬挂其国徽的自由。

剧院停业

位于领事馆路（Rue du Consulat）和蒙梯尼大道（Boulevard de Montigny）拐角处的水晶大戏院（Crystal Theatre），其日场和夜场演出昨日仍暂时停演，因为自上周三被没收以来，法市政许可证尚未归还给戏院管理层。

事发当天，一些中国人与一队法国警察在剧院外发生斗殴。当局命令取下悬挂在剧院前的中国国旗。管理层照办了，但国旗刚降下不久，几个来自不明身份中国人的电话就威胁剧院经理将采取某种报复行动，并指责他缺乏爱国心。管理层因害怕后果，再次将国旗升起。这导致法国当局撤回了演出许可证。

尽管昨日随着所有华商店铺恢复常态，法租界的紧张局势普遍缓和，但作为预防措施，法国警察分队仍驻守在主要街道和繁忙干道的交叉路口，不过幸运的是，未发生任何意外事件。

公共租界警察当局全天也采取了类似的预防措施，但未报告发生任何不愉快的事件。

APR 22 1939

Flag Incident
Editor, THE CHINA PRESS
Sir.—May I use your column to express my personal opinion over the trouble arising out of prohibiting to display Chinese flags in the French town yesterday.
It was the second time that the French Concession barred Chinese residents to hoist Blue-white banners on memorial days of their country. The object of the French authorities in taking this measure is supposedly at suppressing undue or untoward accident that may occur in consequence of different political conception.
However, the local French authorities and their home government are invited to note that flags represent country. As long as the Chinese National Government continues to exist, there is no reason whereby any nation might rely upon to interfere into the Chinese anywhere observing the memorial days of their country.
Furthermore, suppression on one side would often result in doubled reaction on the other. Whereas the local French authorities might have gained some measure of success in the suppression, we could hardly believe that they are not adding to the displeased feeling among Chinese. And things do speak themselves when we find many Chinese shops there cease operation. Though this strike is too minor and short-lived to constitute any significance, yet it speaks loudly for the Chinese reaction against the French suppression.
On the endeavor to maintain international law and justice, China is now, as a boldest country, fighting with one of the world's three aggressors. She should be praised for her courage and intelligence and likewise, should be given every possible assistance by those who love true peace. Under the circumstance, let us hope that, while the French government has done a good part in the recent world crisis, the local French authorities would turn attitude and always have in their minds, the interest of Chinese.
I am,
Yours truly,
Z. P. OUN.
Shanghai, April 20, 1939.

1939年4月22日

国旗事件
致《大美晚报》编辑
先生——请允许我利用贵报专栏，就昨日法租界禁止悬挂中国国旗所引发的纠纷表达我个人意见。
这是法租界第二次禁止中国居民在国家纪念日悬挂青天白日旗。法国当局采取这一措施的目的，据称是为了压制因不同政治观念可能引发的不当或意外事故。
然而，谨请当地法国当局及其本国政府注意，国旗代表国家。只要中国国民政府继续存在，就没有任何理由让任何国家干涉世界各地的中国人庆祝其国家纪念日。
此外，单方面的压制往往会导致双倍的反弹。虽然当地法国当局可能在压制方面取得了一定程度的成功，但我们很难相信他们没有加剧中国人的不满情绪。当我们发现许多中国商店停止营业时，事实本身就说明了问题。虽然这次罢工规模太小且持续时间太短，不足以构成任何重大意义，但它大声宣告了中国人对法国压制的反应。
为了维护国际法和正义，中国目前正作为一个最勇敢的国家，与世界三大侵略者之一作战。她的勇气和智慧应受到赞扬，同样，那些热爱真正和平的人也应给予她一切可能的援助。在这种情况下，我们希望，既然法国政府在近期的世界危机中做了大量有益的工作，当地法国当局能转变态度，始终将中国人的利益铭记于心。
此致
敬礼
Z. P. OUN.
上海，1939年4月20日。

据可靠消息来源昨日获悉，法市政警察于昨晚深夜释放了最后六名因涉嫌在周三挑起国旗事件而被拘留的中国居民。

在此前举行的国民精神总动员运动启动仪式上，当警察分队走访中国商店敦促移除旗杆上的中国国旗时发生冲突，警方共带走了43人。

知情华人圈子表示，虽然法国当局拒绝立即释放这六人，但他们已同意对被拘留者给予“特殊待遇”。预计他们将在未来几天内被“驱逐”出租界。

尽管周四存在的紧张局势有所缓和，但大量的法租界警察继续巡逻由外滩、领事馆路（Rue du Consulat）、蒙梯尼大道（Boulevard de Montigny）和爱德华七世大道（Avenue Edward VII）围成的街道区域。

华人纳税会昨日向中文报纸公布了与法市政警察（F.M.P.）谈判的细节。

该协会向警方提出了三项请求：
1. 释放被捕人员；
2. 将被警方没收的中国国旗归还原主；
3. 不在任何节日或纪念日干涉在法租界悬挂中国国旗。

警方在同意前两项请求的同时，除拒绝释放上述六人外，还告知华人，第三项请求超出了法市政警察的管辖权限，无法批准。
不过，警方建议协会将此事项提交法国领事当局，据说只有后者才能对该请求作出最终裁决。

与此同时，据报道，租界内的中国商号已就国旗事件联合向法国大使亨利·科斯梅先生（M. Henri Cosme）发出呼吁。
据新闻报道，此地华人圈子认为，鉴于这位新使节曾多次努力加强中法之间的友谊纽带，此次事件尤其令人遗憾。

与此同时，日本媒体开始鼓动在公共租界和法租界全面禁止悬挂中国国旗。
一家日本报纸声称，上海的国民党机构应对此处持续悬挂中国国旗负责。

《华威晨报》及其他本地报纸：-

悬旗事件：法国领事承诺今日归还查获的旗帜

关于法租界当局干涉悬挂中国国旗一事，被捕人员虽已获释，但尽管法租界华人纳税会与会审公廨法国警务处长经谈判达成协议，被查获的旗帜尚未归还。公众正密切关注事态发展。各商店多次向华人纳税会查询被法国警察查获的旗帜何时归还。
华人纳税会秘书郭叔亮先生于昨日上午9时前往卢家湾警察局，要求归还被没收的旗帜，但被告知法国总领事尚未就此发出指示。因此，该会委员瞿振華先生于昨日上午10时30分前往法国总领事馆，受到法国副领事布洛特先生（M. Blot）的接见。
在会谈中，瞿先生重申了与法国警务处长达成的协议，即凭该会信函释放被捕人员并归还查获的旗帜，并要求总领事向警方发出归还旗帜的指令。
布洛特先生回答说，一旦完成某些程序，法国当局将按照原协议归还旗帜；他承诺将于今晨，即4月25日，将旗帜交还给该会。

《新闻报》：-

要求工部局禁止悬挂中国国旗

4月21日，日本总领事拜会了工部局董事会主席富兰克林先生（Mr. Franklin），要求禁止在公共租界展示中国国旗。
本报记者昨日向工部局某官员询问董事会对此要求的态度，获悉董事会尚未审议此问题，也未提交董事会会议讨论，因为这是一个非常棘手的问题。

Translation of French Police Report No.
4276/R dated April 21, 1939

Subject : Arrest of one SHEN KI ( 沈冀 ), Writer of
anti-Japanese and communist slogans at the
entrance of Lane 514 Rue Amiral Bayle.

About 7.30 p.m. April 19, 1939, our S.D.C. 338
arrested in front of Lane 514 Rue Amiral Bayle, a young
Chinese who had just written in chalk on the pavement the
following inscriptions :-

1. Glorious soldiers, you will soon be victorious !
2. The cooperation of the Kuomintang with Communism
demonstrates the union of force to resist to the
finish.
3. Resist until death !
4. Long live Bolshevism !
5. Secure the final victory by the blood of martyrs !
6. Resistance to the finish, final victory !
7. Rise-up, traitors and running dogs !
8. To struggle for existence is to struggle for justice !
9. May the National flag drape the glorious dead !
10. Restore our territory !

Taken to the Political Branch, the person arrested
declared his name to be SHEN KI ( 沈冀 ) alias SHEN KOO JEN
( 沈古人 ) and made a statement, which is attached.
From enquiries made by us, it appears that this individual
can be categorised as a stray sheep, whose parents have
had to separate from him on account of his manner of
living and the numerous debts he has contracted.

At the age of 14 years, he was known to the Political
Branch for having participated in a student's movement
directed against the head of the King Ping ( 京平 )
Secondary School, corner of Rues Pere Froc and Chaps
pages.zh:
1939年4月21日第4276/R号法国警察报告译文

主题：逮捕一名在贝勒路（Rue Amiral Bayle）514弄口书写反日和共产主义标语的沈冀（SHEN KI）。

1939年4月19日晚7时30分左右，我方特别侦探338号在贝勒路514弄前逮捕了一名年轻中国人，他刚刚用粉笔在人行道上写下以下文字：-

1. 光荣的士兵们，你们很快就会胜利！
2. 国共合作显示了团结力量抵抗到底的决心。
3. 抵抗至死！
4. 布尔什维克主义万岁！
5. 用烈士的鲜血确保最后胜利！
6. 抵抗到底，最终胜利！
7. 起来，汉奸和走狗们！（原文如此，语境似应为号召反抗，但字面意为攻击对象，或为OCR/原文笔误，此处照实译）
8. 为生存而斗争就是为正义而斗争！
9. 愿国旗覆盖光荣的死者！
10. 收复我们的领土！

该被捕者被带至政治科，自称名为沈冀（SHEN KI），别名沈古人（SHEN KOO JEN），并作了陈述，附件即为该陈述。
经我方调查，此人可归类为浪子，其父母因其生活方式及所欠大量债务而不得不与其断绝关系。

14岁时，他就因参与反对京平中学（King Ping Secondary School，位于蒲石路和查普路转角，该校现已关闭）校长的学生运动而为政治科所知。

which, however, is now closed.
In 1937, he joined the "National Salvation Anti-Japanese Committee," an organ which, according to his statement, was dissolved upon the occupation of Nantao by Japanese troops.
In September 1938, he was a member of a group of Chinese guerillas in the Chinkiang neighbourhood, but later separated from them.
He returned to Shanghai in March 1939 where he found himself with neither work nor home. He draws several meagre amounts from one of his former school-mates named YANG WEI LING( 杨 伟 龄 ) who is now studying at the Chung Hwa School ( 中 华 ), Buntangloong, Honan Road.
----
These facts and the state of mind in which SHEN KI was found to be, brought us to the conclusion that we were in the presence of a political disturber of the peace.
Consular Ordinance No. 251 of September 2, 1937 which allows for the deportation of any individual indulging in political manifestations in the French Concession will, therefore, be applied.
pages.zh:
- 2 -
1937年，他加入了“救国抗日委员会”，据他称，该组织在南市被日军占领后解散。
1938年9月，他是镇江附近一支中国游击队小组的成员，但后来与他们失散。
他于1939年3月回到上海，发现自己既无工作也无家可归。他从一位名叫杨伟龄（YANG WEI LING）的前同学那里获得几笔微薄的资助，杨伟龄目前在河南路本滩龙（音译，Buntangloong）的中华学校（Chung Hwa School）就读。
----
鉴于上述事实以及发现沈冀时的精神状态，我们得出结论，我们面对的是一名政治扰乱治安者。
因此，将适用1937年9月2日第251号领事条例，该条例允许驱逐任何在法租界从事政治示威活动的个人。

Shanghai, April 21, 1939.

STATEMENT

Made on April 21, 1939 in Shanghai by SHEN KI ( 沈 奇 ).

Q: What are your names, age, place of birth, occupation
and domicile ?

A: My name is SHEN KI, alias SHEN KOO JEN, 18 years of age,
a native of Shanghai. At present I am unemployed
and of no fixed abode. Sometimes I live in the
Tung Shing ( 東 成 ) Lodging House, 170 Rue Lafayette
and sometimes at 298/280 Rue Chapsal, the home of
my friend, YANG WEI MING, who is a student in the
Chung Hwa School, Buntangloong, Honan Road.

I was born in Shanghai in 1921; my father SHEN
KVEI LONG ( 沈 桂 隆 ) was Chief of a Chapei Police
Station; he died in 1925.

From seven to twelve years, I was educated in
the "Chuan Chiad ( 傳 家 ) Primary School," Shanghai
sub-prefecture. From 12 to 14 I continued my
studies in the "Nan Tung" Secondary School, in
northern Kiangsu. In 1934 I returned to Shanghai
and for a further year studied at the "King Ping"
( 景 平 ) Secondary School at the corner of Rues
Pere Froc and Chapsal. It is now closed. While
attending the last mentioned school, I participated
in a movement directed against the head of the
institution, in consequence of which I was called to
the Political Branch for purposes of interrogation.
From September 1936 to January 1937, I worked as an
apprentice in the Farmers' Bank of China at Hsiang
Tan ( 湘 潭 ), Hunan. Falling seriously ill, I
returned to Shanghai in early 1937. From February
to July 1937, I remained at home unemployed. From
pages.zh:
上海，1939年4月21日。

陈述书

由沈奇（SHEN KI）于1939年4月21日在上海作出。

问：你的姓名、年龄、出生地、职业及住址是什么？

答：我叫沈奇，别名沈古仁（SHEN KOO JEN），18岁，上海人。目前无业，居无定所。有时我住在拉斐特路（Rue Lafayette）170号的东成（Tung Shing）客栈，有时住在霞飞路（Rue Chapsal）298/280号我的朋友杨伟明（YANG WEI MING）家中，他是河南路本滩龙（Buntangloong）中华学校的学生。

我于1921年出生在上海；父亲沈桂隆（SHEN KVEI LONG）曾任闸北一警察分局局长；他于1925年去世。

七岁至十二岁期间，我在上海县传家（Chuan Chiad）小学受教育。十二岁至十四岁期间，我在江苏北部的南通中学继续求学。1934年我回到上海，在福罗神甫路（Rue Pere Froc）与霞飞路（Rue Chapsal）转角处的景平（King Ping）中学又读了一年书。该校现已关闭。在读上述最后一所学校期间，我参与了一场针对该校校长的运动，因此被传唤至政治部接受审讯。1936年9月至1937年1月，我在湖南湘潭的中国农民银行当学徒。因患重病，我于1937年初返回上海。1937年2月至7月，我在家待业。从

pages.en:
- 2 -

the start of the Sino-Japanese hostilities, I have been a
member of the "Anti-Japanese National Salvation Committee."
Following the retreat of the Nationalist troops, I took
refuge in the village of Hoi An Cheng, Tai An, Northern
Kiangsu, in my aunt's home, at the request of my mother
who loved me still. In April 1938 I returned to Shanghai
and resided with my mother SHEN GUI SZE ( 沈桂氏 ) at No.
18 Kang Yi Li ( 康义里 ), Route Conty.
As I was without work and my mother was unable
to support me she announced in the press (Sin Wan Pao)
on September 16, 1938 that she was separating from me
and that she would take no responsibility for my future
activities. Lawyer WANG DAH TSONG, whose office is in
San Chiang Fang, Rue du Marche, witnessed this announcement.
After having secured $100 I also signed a bond separating
me from my family.
On September 21, 1938 I proceeded to Chinkiang
where I worked with a group of Chinese guerillas. Not
being in agreement with the leaders of this band who
were just bandits, I returned to Shanghai on March 12, 1939.
I am now living on the help given me by my friend
YANG WEI MING ( 杨伟民 ), mentioned higher.
Q: Are you a member of the Chinese Communist Party?
A: I have not yet joined the Party, but I believe in its
doctrines. If it is possible, I intend to enrol in
the Communist 4th Army now operating in Kiangsu and
Anhwei.
Q: How were you directed to inscribe the communist and anti-
Japanese slogans on the pavement opposite 514 Rue
Amiral Bayle and from whom did you receive such
instructions ?
A: I believe in the principles of the Communist Party and
it was on my own initiative that I wrote these slogans
pages.zh:
- 2 -

中日战事爆发伊始，我便成为“抗日救国会”的成员。随着国军撤退，应仍疼爱我的母亲请求，我避难至江苏北部泰安的海安镇（Hoi An Cheng），寄居在姨妈家。1938年4月我回到上海，与母亲沈桂氏（SHEN GUI SZE）居住在康义里18号。

由于我没有工作，母亲无力供养我，她便于1938年9月16日在报纸（《新闻报》）上刊登声明，宣布与我断绝关系，并对我不再承担未来行为的责任。该声明由市场路三江坊的王大松（WANG DAH TSONG）律师见证。在获得100美元后，我也签署了一份与家人脱离关系的保证书。

1938年9月21日，我前往镇江，与一群中国游击队一起工作。因与该团伙首领意见不合——他们实为匪徒——我于1939年3月12日返回上海。目前我靠上述朋友杨伟明（杨伟民）的资助生活。

问：你是中国共产党党员吗？

答：我尚未入党，但我信奉其主义。如果可能，我打算加入目前在江苏和安徽作战的共产党第四军。

问：是谁指示你在贝勒路（Rue Amiral Bayle）514号对面的人行道上书写共产主义和抗日标语的？你是从谁那里接到这些指示的？

答：我信奉共产党的原则，书写这些标语是我自发的举动，

pages.en:
- 3 -
to advise the populace and to maintain their patriotic
spirit.
Q: Your activities are covered by Consular Ordinance No. 251
of September 2, 1937 which provides for the deportation
from the French Concession, of any individual
indulging in activities endangering peace and safety.
Have you anything else to say in your defence ?
A: I have acted from patriotic motives and I do not regret
what I have done.
pages.zh:
- 3 -
旨在劝导民众并保持他们的爱国精神。

问：你的活动受1937年9月2日第251号领事条例管辖，该条例规定将任何从事危害和平与安全活动的人员从法租界驱逐出境。你还有什么要为自己辩护的吗？

答：我是出于爱国动机行事，对我所做之事并不后悔。

法租界国旗事件

截至本报告付印时，被法国警察扣押的旗帜尚未归还。

April 22, 1939. Morning Translation.
Ta . ei Wan Pao (Comment) dated April 21 :-
No Right to Interfere With Flag Hoisting

A serious dispute took place in the French Concession on April 19, the propaganda day for peasants, workers and commercial circles, over the hoisting of national flags. It is indeed a matter for profound regret that such an important incident should have taken place. It has intensified the unification and determination of the residents.
A third party has absolutely no right to trespass upon the administrative rights of the French Concession, nor have the Concession authorities the right to interfere with the hoisting of the national flag. The flag of Albania, a conquered country, is still being displayed in New York, then all the much more should the flag of China be allowed to be hoisted for China is an independent nation and the French Concession is not a colony of a third nation but is part and parcel of China's territory.
It is the right of any people to hoist their national flag. So long as their country exists as an independent nation, such a right and freedom is to be enjoyed by the people free from any unreasonable interference by the authorities.
So far we are still ignorant of the cause of the French Police action in prohibiting the display of the Chinese national flag. We hope that this incident arose through a misunderstanding and that the French authorities will voluntarily do something to remove this misunderstanding.
As regards the Chinese people, they should curb their impulsiveness and wait calmly for a proper solution of the affair lest traitorous elements, who are eagerly waiting for an aggravation of the incident, should take advantage of the opportunity to instigate trouble. We should remain calm and patient and be careful not to fall into the trap of a "third party."
There is absolutely no doubt that we must resist unreasonable oppression, but such resistance must be carried out in a peaceful manner. We must bear in mind that the "spirit of resistance," as that adopted by Mr. Gandhi, is well worth adopting. So long as the residents are unanimous in their determination and adopt a resolute but calm attitude to deal with the present affair, we may expect justice and righteousness to prevail.

Shun Pao (Editorial) dated April 21 :-

The flag incident in the French Concession has been temporarily settled and the question will be left to the high authorities for final settlement.
Many rumours were prevalent after the flag incident. Some regarded the incident as having been instigated by the Kuomintang and the Communist Party, while others say that the incident had revealed that the French people are flattering the strong and oppressing the weak. All such sayings are without foundation.

1939年4月22日。晨间译文。
4月21日《大晚报》（评论）：
无权干涉升旗

4月19日，正值农、工、商界宣传日，法租界因悬挂国旗一事发生严重纠纷。如此重要事件竟会发生，实令人深感遗憾。此事加剧了居民的团结和决心。
第三方绝对无权侵犯法租界的行政权，租界当局也无权干涉悬挂国旗。阿尔巴尼亚作为一个被征服的国家，其国旗仍在纽约展示，那么中国作为一个独立国家，更应允许悬挂其国旗，况且法租界并非第三国的殖民地，而是中国领土不可分割的一部分。
任何人民都有权悬挂其国旗。只要其国家作为独立民族存在，人民就应享有这种权利和自由，不受当局任何不合理的干涉。
截至目前，我们仍不清楚法国警察禁止展示中国国旗的原因。我们希望此事源于误会，并期望法国当局自愿采取行动消除这一误会。
至于中国人民，他们应克制冲动，冷静等待此事得到妥善解决，以免那些急切等待事态恶化的奸佞之徒利用机会煽动骚乱。我们应保持冷静和耐心，小心不要落入“第三方”的陷阱。
毫无疑问，我们必须抵抗不合理的压迫，但这种抵抗必须以和平方式进行。我们必须牢记，甘地先生所采用的“抵抗精神”非常值得效仿。只要居民决心一致，以坚定但冷静的态度处理当前事务，我们可以期待正义得以伸张。

4月21日《申报》（社论）：

法租界国旗事件已暂时平息，该问题将留待高层当局最终解决。
国旗事件后谣言四起。有人认为该事件是由国民党和共产党煽动的，也有人说该事件暴露了法国人欺软怕硬。所有这些说法均无根据。

April 22, 1939. Morning Translation,

At present the Kuomintang and the Communist
Party are engaged in a war of resistance and in the
reconstruction of the nation, therefore they have no
desire to create any trouble. France is working together
with Great Britain for an anti-aggression understanding
in order to help the weak and she will never flatter
the strong or oppress the weak.
During the war of resistance, the Chinese

would not like to have any trouble with foreign nations.
China wants assistance from friendly nations for her

A false allegation is being made that
a victory for China in her war of resistance will prove

SHANGHAI TIMES.
（印：S. E. REGISTRY No. S. A. D.）
APR 25 1939

Chungking Still Discussing
Frenchtown “Flag” Dispute

A wire from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs stating that negotiations have been carried on with the French Embassy in Chungking over the “flag incident” in the French Concession in Shanghai, has been received by the local Chinese public bodies, it was reliably reported yesterday.

The local Chinese public bodies had previously petitioned the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, following the unpleasant “flag incident,” urging that a strong protest be lodged with the French Embassy authorities, and requesting that steps be taken to safeguard the freedom of Chinese citizens to hoist their national flags on appropriate occasions. The French authorities were also requested to guarantee that no similar “flag incident” should occur again in the Concession.

According to Chinese reports, the Chinese national flags seized by the French municipal police last Wednesday had not yet been returned to their rightful owners last weekend as was earlier expected. A spokesman of the F.M.C., when asked by the “Shanghai Times” yesterday afternoon, declared that the flags were to be returned to their owners yesterday.

The Chinese Ratepayers’ Association in the French Concession, Chinese reports stated, had approached the F.M.P. to request that these flags be restored to the Chinese shops at an early date. This, the Chinese claim, was one of the conditions in the Sino-French compromise measure which amicably settled the “flag incident,” towards the end of last week.

1939年4月25日

重庆仍在讨论
法租界“国旗”争端

据可靠消息，本地华人公共团体昨日收到外交部来电，称已在重庆与法国大使馆就上海法租界“国旗事件”进行谈判。

此前，在不愉快的“国旗事件”发生后，本地华人公共团体曾向外交部请愿，敦促向法国大使馆当局提出强烈抗议，并要求采取措施保障中国公民在适当场合悬挂国旗的自由。还要求法国当局保证租界内不再发生类似的“国旗事件”。

据中文报道，上周三被法国市警扣押的中国国旗，截至上周末仍未如早前预期那样归还原主。《字林西报》昨日下午询问法公董局（F.M.C.）发言人时，该发言人宣称旗帜将于昨日归还原主。

据中文报道，法租界华人纳税会已接触法国市警（F.M.P.），要求尽早将这些旗帜归还给中国商店。中方称，这是上周末友好解决“国旗事件”的中法妥协措施中的条件之一。

April 20, 1939. Morning Translation.

French Police Issue Proclamation

On April 19 the French authorities issued
the following proclamation:-
"Notice is hereby given that in the French
Concession political demonstrations are strictly
forbidden on the ground that such demonstrations will
lead to disturbances and menace peace and good order and
might have been instigated by bad elements. Apart from
taking the necessary steps, the authorities will maintain
the neutrality of the Concession and will undertake full
responsibility for the protection of the residents. If
necessary, the authorities will expel bad elements.
As regards the collective display of the national
flag, such display has the meaning of a political
demonstration and is prohibited, except in the case of
national celebrations. This notice is again issued
for the information of all residents."

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese owned Chinese language newspaper) :-

Police Action Taken at Request of Shanghai City Government

Yesterday being the propaganda day for the
peasants, workers and commercial circles of the propaganda
week of the national spiritual mobilization, the Chinese
national flag was hoisted by all the shops in the Foreign
Settlements. They were however removed by the Police of
the Foreign Settlements and taken to police stations.
This action was taken by the authorities at the request
of the Shanghai City Government.

Ta Mei Pao and other local newspapers :-

Final Warning Issued by China Youths' Patriotic Salvation
Association

On April 18 identical letters issued by the
so-called "China Youths' Patriotic Salvation Association"
were received by all Chinese language newspapers of
British, American and other foreign ownership.
Yesterday the following final warning addressed
to the 3,000,000 Chinese residents in Shanghai was issued
by the Association:-
"Unless the residents discontinue the hoisting
of the blue sky and white sun flag, bullets and bombs
will be used against those who disregard this warning."
A written copy of this warning was received
by the "Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury" yesterday. It
reads as follows:-
"The national flag is a symbol of a nation.
Following the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese hostilities,
this Association has on several occasions issued warnings
to the residents of the two Foreign Settlements against the
hoisting of the blue sky and white sun flag, but the warnings
were ignored. Therefore a final warning was issued
yesterday urging the residents to come to their senses.
Unless they modify their present attitude, bullets and bombs
will be used against them. The public are hereby warned
not to complain of not having being informed beforehand
if their lives are endangered for hoisting such flags."

1939年4月20日。晨间译文。

法国警方发布公告

4月19日，法国当局发布了以下公告：-
“兹通告，鉴于此类示威将导致骚乱并威胁和平与良好秩序，且可能由不良分子策动，法租界内严禁政治示威。当局除采取必要步骤外，将维持租界的中立，并承担保护居民的全部责任。如有必要，当局将驱逐不良分子。关于集体展示国旗，此种展示具有政治示威的性质，除在国家庆典场合外，一律禁止。特此再次发布本通知，以供所有居民知悉。”

《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）：-

应上海市政府要求警方采取行动

昨日正值国民精神总动员宣传周中面向农民、工人及商界的宣传日，各外国租界内的商铺均悬挂了中国国旗。然而，这些旗帜被外国租界警方拆除并没收至警察局。此举是当局应上海市政府的要求而采取的。

《大美报》及其他本地报纸：-

中国青年救国协会发出最后警告

4月18日，所有英、美及其他外资背景的中文报纸均收到了所谓“中国青年救国协会”发出的内容相同的信件。
昨日，该协会向上海300万中国居民发出了如下最后警告：-
“除非居民停止悬挂青天白日旗，否则将对无视此警告者使用子弹和炸弹。”
《上海晚邮报与水星报》（Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury）于昨日收到了一份该警告的书面副本。内容如下：-
“国旗是一个国家的象征。自中日敌对行动爆发以来，本协会已多次向两外国租界的居民发出警告，劝阻其悬挂青天白日旗，但这些警告被忽视。因此，昨日发出最后警告，敦促居民清醒过来。除非他们改变目前的态度，否则将对其使用子弹和炸弹。特此警告公众，若因悬挂此类旗帜而危及生命，不得抱怨事先未获告知。”

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS,
APR 24 1939

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY S. B. D.）

Chungking Lodges
Flag Protest

Dissatisfaction at French
Concession Action

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs at
Chungking has formally lodged a
protest with the French Ambassador
to China against the removal of Chi-
nese national flags in the French Con-
cession in Shanghai last week when
the flags were hoisted to celebrate
the opening of the general spiritual
mobilization campaign.
Although the incident has been set-
tled locally, the Ministry is reported
by a message from Chungking to be
still dissatisfied and wishes the French
authorities to guarantee against its
repetition. It is revealed that prior
to the latest incident the Ministry has
twice made representations against
similar incidents.
Local Chinese reports indicate that
the incident has not yet been com-
pletely settled as some persons ar-
rested in connection with the incident
are still being detained and that flags
taken down by the French police have
not yet been returned. It is expect-
ed, however, that these flags will be
returned to-morrow to the Chinese
Ratepayers Association in the French
Concession.
Chinese residents in the Concession
wish that the incident will be settled
completely, for next month there will
be many occasions when flag display
is necessary. They are reported to
have urged the ratepayers association
to conduct further negotiations in
order to reach a "rational" settlement.
It was previously reported that wish-
ing to maintain strict neutrality auth-
orities of the French Concession here
would not allow the flying of Chi-
nese flags on any occasions excepting
the Chinese national holiday.

重庆方面就
旗帜抗议提出交涉

对法租界
行动的不满

重庆外交部已正式向法国驻华大使提出抗议，反对上周在法租界移除中国国旗的行为，当时悬挂国旗是为了庆祝国民精神总动员运动的启动。
尽管此事已在当地得到解决，但据来自重庆的消息称，外交部仍表示不满，并希望法国当局保证不再重演此类事件。据悉，在此次最新事件之前，外交部已就类似事件两次提出交涉。
当地中文报道指出，此事尚未完全解决，因为一些与此事有关而被捕的人仍被拘留，且被法国警察撤下的旗帜尚未归还。不过，预计这些旗帜将于明天归还给法租界华人纳税会。
租界内的中国居民希望此事能得到彻底解决，因为下个月将有许多需要展示旗帜的场合。据报道，他们已敦促纳税会进行进一步谈判，以达成“合理”的解决方案。
此前有报道称，为了保持严格的中立，法租界当局不允许在任何场合悬挂中国国旗，除中国国庆日外。

April 18, 1939. Afternoon Translation.

Chinese-American Daily News and other local newspapers :-

NATIONAL SPIRITUAL MOBILIZATION PROPAGANDA WEEK

To-day being the citizens propaganda day
of the national spiritual mobilization propaganda week,
the Shanghai Citizens' National Spiritual Mobilization
Association has issued the following manifesto :-
"The war of resistance has entered the
second stage. During this period we should adopt
the offensive instead of the defensive so as to recover
the lost territory and establish a New China. In
order to achieve this, the national spiritual mobilization
is necessary so that people throughout the country may
struggle for the salvation of the nation under the
direction of a united organization.
"In the past, certain persons thought that
China, being a weak country, will not be able to withstand
the enemy. Some became very happy upon hearing of
victories from the front, while others became disappointed
upon learning of the loss of a large city. Many paid
no attention to the war. Such behaviour will certainly
affect the war of resistance.
"China is now face to face with a most
dangerous crisis. The strength of the 450,000,000
people should be employed in the defence of the country
and to drive away the enemy. Thus, final victory may
be assured. The object of the national spiritual
mobilization is to unify and strengthen the people's
organization and to correct all improper habits and
thoughts. This Association hopes that local Chinese
citizens will join."

To-morrow will be the propaganda day for
farmers, labourers and merchants. The responsible
persons of the National Spiritual Mobilization Association
of these circles the other day held a meeting, at which
it was resolved to issue an open letter addressed to
farmers, labourers and merchants and to advise shops,
factories and residents to hoist the national flag on
April 19. Therefore, the national flag will be flown
to-morrow to mark the spirit of the national spiritual
mobilization.

PIG HONG OWNERS' GUILD PUBLISHES A NOTICE

The following notice appears in the advertise-
ment columns of the "Shun Pao" and other local newspapers:-
To .........
The letters and articles sent by you to
this Association and member hongs have been received.
Both this Association and member hongs have always
adopted an attitude of non-co-operation with illegal
organizations. Prior to receipt of your letter, we
had already directed fellow merchants to express our
stand and issued a joint manifesto.
We hereby publish this notice as a reply to
your letter.
The Shanghai Pig Hong Owners' Guild.

CHINA PRESS
APR 21 1939
“Flag Incident” In French Concession Brought To End
Chinese Shops Re-open, As Police Reportedly Release Detained Men, Return Flags

Chinese shops in Frenchtown, closed since Wednesday, reopened for business at 5 p.m. yesterday following an amicable settlement of the incidents, caused by the official ban on the hoisting of the Chinese national flag.
The settlement was reached between officials of the French Municipal Council and representatives of the Chinese shop owners.
An unconfirmed report indicated that the French Police had released all the Chinese who were detained on Wednesday and had returned all flags seized by the police during several affrays.
Acting in behalf of the Chinese shop owners was the Chinese Rate-payers Association, which earlier yesterday circularized a statement urging the reopening of the shops.

Statement Issued

The statement indicated that negotiations with the French authorities were in progress and declared that resumption of business was necessary to preserve Sino-French friendship.
Meanwhile it was learned that despite the slight tension which continued to exist yesterday, there were no organized disturbances in the Concession.
The French Police in the evening summarized the situation in an abbreviated press release:
“Calm continued to reign in the French Concession during the day.
“Those persons who had been arrested yesterday (Wednesday) have been released except for two or three agitators.
“A certain number of shops which closed their doors during the morning have reopened.”

Volunteers Said Attacked

No mention was made of reports that two Russian volunteers of the French Police were set upon by a crowd of Chinese on Rue du Consulat yesterday morning. Neither was the arrest of four or five Chinese by French Police yesterday noon announced. These men, THE CHINA PRESS learned last night, were taken into custody for chalking patriotic slogans on walls and pavements.
Although a number of Chinese shops and offices in Frenchtown remained closed yesterday morning, it was confirmed yesterday that the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in the afternoon issued an order requesting the resumption of business. Most of the business houses reopened.
While some stores took the precaution to cover their showwindows with wooden boards or iron grilles, their doors remained opened.

《字林西报》
1939年4月21日
法租界“国旗事件”告终
据报警方释放被拘人员并归还国旗，中国商店重新开业

自周三以来关闭的法租界（Frenchtown）中国商店，在因官方禁止悬挂中国国旗而引发的事件达成和解后，于昨日下午5时重新营业。
该和解是在法国公董局官员与中国店主代表之间达成的。
有未经证实的消息称，法国警察已释放周三被拘留的所有中国人，并归还了在几次冲突中被警察没收的所有国旗。
代表中国店主行事的是华人纳税会，该会昨早曾发布通函，敦促商店重新开业。

发表声明

声明指出，与法国当局的谈判正在进行中，并宣称恢复营业对于维护中法友谊是必要的。
与此同时，获悉尽管昨日紧张局势略有持续，但租界内没有发生有组织的骚乱。
法国警察在晚间通过一份简略的新闻稿总结了局势：
“白天法租界继续保持平静。
“除两三名煽动者外，昨日（周三）被捕的人员已被释放。
“上午关门的部分商店已重新开业。”

据称志愿者遭袭击

对于昨日上午在领事馆路上两名俄国籍法国警察志愿者遭到一群中国人袭击的报道，新闻稿只字未提。法国警察昨日中午逮捕四五名中国人的消息也未公布。《字林西报》昨晚获悉，这些人因在墙壁和人行道上书写爱国标语而被拘留。
虽然昨日上午法租界内的许多中国商店和办事处仍然关闭，但昨日确认，中国商会于下午发布命令，要求恢复营业。大多数商行重新开业。
虽然一些商店采取预防措施，用木板或铁栅栏遮盖橱窗，但大门依然敞开。

Theater Suspended
The Crystal Palace, Peiping opera house located at the Rue du Consulat-Boulevard de Montigny intersection, remained closed yesterday. It was learned that Frenchtown authorities suspended the theater's permit following a clash outside the amusement center Wednesday morning, when police squads were ordering down all flags. Later reports stated that the operating license would be reinstated within a day or two.
The suspension of the permit followed a mob scene outside the theater at 11 a.m. Wednesday. Shortly before this hour the theater complied with the police order and lowered its flag. Almost immediately it received a mysterious telephone message from a man claiming to represent "patriotic citizens" demanding that the flag be flown again.

Hoist Flag Again
Fearing trouble the theater again hoisted the White-Sun-Blue-Sky banner. This was hauled down and confiscated shortly after by a police party which arrived on the scene. A large crowd gathered to shout slogans and boo at the police. Several men were arrested.
Shortly after the noon hour yesterday French police posted proclamations on walls and telephone poles on main thoroughfares reiterating the ban on political manifestations of any kind.
Details of the assault upon two Russian volunteers of the French Police were not available last night, but an eye-witness reported that he saw the men set upon by an angry crowd on Rue du Consulat. Police made no mention of the incident in their press release.
French Police armored cars and increased point-duty squads continued to patrol the congested shopping district of the Concession yesterday.

S.M.C. Attacked
Once more the Tairiku Shimpo, local Japanese daily, took this advantage to attack the S.M.C. yesterday. The paper charged that the raising of Kuomintang flags in the International Settlement, in contrast to their forced removal in the French Concession on Wednesday, the second day of the Spiritual Mobilization, was "obviously intended to fan the anti-Japanese war spirit."
The Tairiku Shimpo also charged that the Settlement had "discarded its neutrality," and in general repeated the things it said of the Settlement after the previous and identical situation which occurred on the anniversary of Sun Yat-sen's birthday on March 12.
pages.zh:
戏院停业
位于领事馆路（Rue du Consulat）与蒙梯尼大道（Boulevard de Montigny）交叉口的京剧戏院“水晶宫”（Crystal Palace）昨日仍闭门未开。据悉，法租界当局在该娱乐中心外于周三上午发生冲突、警队下令降下所有旗帜之后，暂停了该戏院的执照。后续消息称，其营业许可证将在一两天内恢复。

暂停执照之举，系因周三上午11时戏院外发生骚乱。在此时刻前不久，戏院遵从警方命令降下了旗帜。几乎随即，它接到一通神秘电话，来电者声称代表“爱国公民”，要求重新升起旗帜。

再次升旗
因担心惹出麻烦，戏院再次升起了青天白日旗。随后不久，一支抵达现场的警察分队将该旗降下并没收。大批民众聚集，高呼口号并向警察发出嘘声。数人被捕。
昨日午后不久，法国警察在主要干道的墙壁和电线杆上张贴告示，重申禁止任何形式的政治示威。
关于两名法国警察俄籍志愿人员遭袭击的细节，昨晚尚无法获悉，但一名目击者称，他看见这些人在领事馆路上遭到愤怒人群的围攻。警方在其新闻稿中未提及此事。
昨日，法国警察的装甲车及增派的定点执勤小队继续在租界拥挤的商业区巡逻。

工部局遭抨击
本地日文日报《大陆新报》昨日再次借机攻击上海公共租界工部局（S.M.C.）。该报指控，与国际租界内悬挂国民党旗帜形成对比的是，这些旗帜在周三——即“国民精神总动员”的第二日——在法租界被强制移除，此举“显然是为了煽动反日战争情绪”。
《大陆新报》还指控工部局已“抛弃其中立立场”，并大体重复了其在3月12日孙中山诞辰纪念日发生类似情况后对工部局的指责。

SHANGHAI TIMES,
APR 21 1939

Chinese Merchants Lodge A
Protest With M. Fabre

Chinese Shops In Concession Remain Closed As
Demonstration Against Lowering Of National
Flags On Wednesday By The French Police

The principal thoroughfares of the French Concession looked strange yesterday when most of the big Chinese shops remained open only partially in protest against the seizure of several Chinese national flags the day before, the "National Spiritual Mobilization Day" ordered by the Chinese Government.

A delegation of Chinese merchants called on Major L. Fabre, Commissioner of the French Municipal Police, in the morning, and had a lengthy discussion with him. The Chinese merchants requested Major Fabre to effect the release of all the Chinese arrested on Wednesday following scuffles with the French Municipal Police during the "flag incidents."

Major Fabre, it was reported, promised to consider the request, and later called upon the French Consul-General, M. Baudez, for further conversations on the matter.

When asked by "The Shanghai Times" for a statement, Major Fabre yesterday afternoon declined to reveal the exact nature of the verbal promise he was reported to have made to the Chinese merchant delegation, but stated that "all the Chinese arrested the day before have now been released, excepting a few agitators."

Shops Said Reopening

"Everything is now quiet and normal, and all the shops are reopening," Major Fabre declared. "I can't tell a newspaper everything about our talks to-day," he concluded, and left the matter at that.

The French Police Commissioner was also understood to have prevailed upon the Chinese delegation to use its influence to effect the reopening of all the Chinese shops in the Concession areas. Up till late yesterday afternoon, however, most of these shops had remained partially closed.

Throughout the whole morning and during the greater part of the afternoon, squads of French police constables, Annamite and Russian police contingents were posted at the intersections of the principal streets as a precautionary measure.

French municipal circulars, printed in Chinese, were being distributed from house to house yesterday morning by the police. The circulars reaffirmed the order issued on the previous day, that political demonstrations, in whatever form they might assume, would be absolutely forbidden in the Concession. National flags could only be hoisted on the Chinese National Day, and not otherwise.

Meanwhile, keen attention was being displayed by local Chinese circles yesterday, following the wire sent jointly by local Chinese public bodies to the Chungking Chinese Government requesting that representations be made to the French authorities over the "flag incident".

Chinese Press Comment

Discussing the incident, the "Shun Pao," an influential local newspaper in Chinese business and commercial circles, declared, "Ever since the outbreak of the current Sino-Japanese hostilities, the Chinese people and the French Concession authorities have maintained very close friendly relations."

The "flag incident" on Wednesday and some time ago, the journal maintained, had been caused by "misunderstanding, which showed the gravity of the situation."

The French municipal authorities, the "Shun Pao" declared, should have given previous notice to the Chinese people and stated why the hoisting of Chinese flags would be prohibited. Flag-hoisting, unless previously prohibited, would not be in contravention of the French municipal police regulations, and and was a legitimate expression of duty of the Chinese people. The journal strongly criticized the methods employed by the French municipal police which, it maintained, had greatly incensed the Chinese populace.

It warned against any precipitate action on the part of the French municipal police authorities resulting in consequences which would be "unthinkable." It is admirable, the "Shun Pao" stated, that nothing more than small conflicts had occurred on Wednesday.

In conclusion, the local Chinese community was urged to remain calm and not to conduct itself in any way that would deteriorate the present situation.

Official Statement

The following official statement was issued by the French Police yesterday evening:—

"Calm continued to reign in the French Concession during the whole of the day.

"Those who had been arrested during the course of the previous day were released, with the exception of two or three agitators.

"A certain number of shops which had shut their doors in the morning re-opened."

Arrests Made

Three Chinese assistants of a shop house at 172, Route Porte de L'Ouest, who were arrested on Wednesday morning after a brawl with French municipal police, who attempted to seize the Chinese national flag from the shop front, were reported to have been released after being fined $12.

Forty other Chinese were reported to have been arrested on Wednesday, and, according to Chinese reports, they had not been released up till yesterday, although Major Fabre revealed yesterday afternoon that "all except a few" have been released.

Last night, practically all the Chinese shop houses re-opened their doors for business as usual, and crowds, too, returned to the streets, indicating that the situation generally had returned to normal.

《字林西报》，
1939年4月21日

华商向法布尔先生提出抗议

为抗议法国警察周三降下国旗，法租界华商铺户继续停业

昨日，法租界的主要干道景象异样，大多数大型华商铺户仅部分开门，以此抗议前一日——即中国政府规定的“国民精神总动员日”——数面中国国旗被收缴一事。

上午，一个华商代表团拜访了法国市警察局总监L. 法布尔（L. Fabre）少校，并与他进行了长时间交谈。华商请求法布尔少校促成释放所有在周三“旗帜事件”期间与法国市警察发生肢体冲突后被捕的华人。

据报道，法布尔少校答应考虑这一请求，随后又拜会了法国总领事博德兹（Baudez）先生，就此事进行进一步商谈。

当《字林西报》记者昨日下午请其发表声明时，法布尔少校拒绝透露据称他对华商代表团所作口头承诺的具体性质，但表示，“除少数煽动者外，前一天被捕的所有华人现已获释。”

称商铺将重新开业

“目前一切平静正常，所有商铺正在重新开业，”法布尔少校宣称。“我不能把今天会谈的所有内容都告诉报纸，”他最后说道，至此不再多言。

据悉，这位法国警察总监还说服华商代表团利用其影响力，促使法租界地区的所有华商铺户重新开业。然而，直到昨日下午晚些时候，大多数此类商铺仍保持部分关闭状态。

整个上午及下午大部分时间，作为预防措施，法国巡捕、安南籍及俄籍警察分队被部署在主要街道的交叉路口。

昨日早晨，警察挨家挨户分发印有中文的法国市政通告。通告重申了前一天发布的命令，即在租界内绝对禁止任何形式的政治示威。国旗仅可在中国国庆日悬挂，其他时间不得悬挂。

与此同时，鉴于本地华人团体联合向重庆中国政府发电，请求就“旗帜事件”向法国当局提出交涉，本地华人圈子昨日对此表现出密切关注。

中文报刊评论

 influential local newspaper in Chinese business and commercial circles 《申报》在讨论此事件时宣称：“自当前中日敌对行动爆发以来，中国人民与法租界当局一直保持着非常密切的友好关系。”

该报认为，周三及此前发生的“旗帜事件”是由“误解”引起的，这显示了局势的严重性。

《申报》宣称，法国市政当局本应事先通知中国人民，并说明为何禁止悬挂中国国旗。除非事先禁止，否则悬挂旗帜并不违反法国市警察条例，且是中国人民履行义务的正当表达。该报强烈批评法国市警察所采用的方法，称其极大地激怒了中国民众。

该报警告法国市警察当局不要采取任何轻率行动，以免导致“难以想象”的后果。《申报》称，值得称赞的是，周三仅发生了小规模冲突。

最后，呼吁本地华人社区保持冷静，不要以任何可能恶化当前局势的方式行事。

官方声明

法国警察于昨晚发布如下官方声明：—

“全天法租界继续保持平静。

“前一天被捕的人员已获释，除两三名煽动者外。

“若干上午关门的商铺已重新开业。”

逮捕情况

据报道，西路门牌172号一家商铺的三名华人店员，在周三上午因试图从店面前方夺取中国国旗而与法国市警察发生斗殴后被捕，在被罚款12元后获释。

另有四十名华人据报于周三被捕，且据中方消息，截至昨日他们尚未获释，尽管法布尔少校昨日下午透露，“除少数人外”均已获释。

昨晚，几乎所有华商铺户重新开门照常营业，人群也回到街头，表明局势总体已恢复正常。

CHINA PRESS.

APR 21 1939

Moderation Needed

THE unfortunate incident in the French Concession arising out of the controversy over the hoisting of the Chinese national flags can only be liquidated by a display of moderation by both the Chinese and the Frenchtown officials.

Incidents connected with national flags require, by their very nature, extremely delicate handling. This journal believes that a sane realization on the part of the Chinese of the difficult situation which the Frenchtown officials are now forced to face and a similar realization on the part of the Concession authorities of the sentiments of the Chinese people will help greatly toward eliminating the friction which exists at the present time.

There is one thing which deserves the attention of the Frenchtown officials who are undoubtedly anxious to avoid the recurrence of a similar unpleasant incident in the future. On Wednesday when the Chinese residents and shopkeepers were asked to display their flags by their respective organizations, there was no general notice issued by the French Municipal Council prohibiting a flag display. Had such a notice been issued, we are sure, there would have been considerably less friction and misunderstanding. In order to avoid any similar incident in the future, the French Municipal Council should immediately make its position clear to Frenchtown's Chinese residents on the question of flag display. The Chinese people have always been known for their reasonableness, and they can be best appealed to by reason instead of by force. The French Concession authorities should constantly keep this in mind in the future when dealing with delicate questions of a similar nature.

From whatever point of view both the Chinese people and the French officials should realize that their traditional friendship must not be marred by hostile feelings arising out of an isolated incident. For the Chinese they must appreciate the fact that this is the time for them to conserve their goodwill. For the French, they must look beyond the present extraordinary situation toward a time when friendship with the Chinese will be a valuable asset for their Far Eastern interests. That is why we counsel moderation and deprecate any development which tends to aggravate the situation.

《大美晚报》

1939年4月21日

需要克制

法租界因悬挂中国国旗争议而引发的不幸事件，唯有通过中方和法方官员双方展现克制才能得以解决。

涉及国旗的事件，就其性质而言，需要极其谨慎的处理。本报认为，如果中国人能理智地认识到法方官员目前被迫面临的困难局面，而租界当局也能同样理解中国人民的情感，将极大有助于消除目前存在的摩擦。

有一件事值得 undoubtedly anxious to avoid the recurrence of a similar unpleasant incident in the future 的法方官员注意。周三，当中国居民和店主被各自组织要求展示旗帜时，法国公董局并未发布禁止展示旗帜的普遍通告。我们确信，若发布了此类通告，摩擦和误解将会大大减少。为避免将来发生类似事件，法国公董局应立即就旗帜展示问题向法租界的中国居民明确其立场。中国人民一直以通情达理著称，对他们诉诸理性而非武力最为有效。法国租界当局在今后处理此类敏感问题时，应时刻牢记这一点。

无论从何种角度来看，中国人民和法国官员都应意识到，他们的传统友谊不应因孤立事件引发的敌对情绪而受到损害。对于中国人来说，他们必须认识到现在是珍惜其善意的时候。对于法国人来说，他们必须超越当前的特殊局势，着眼于未来，届时与中国的友谊将成为其在远东利益的宝贵资产。这就是为什么我们劝告克制，并反对任何倾向于加剧局势的事态发展。

April 21, 1939.
Morning Translation

Eastern Times and other local newspapers :-

THE FLAG HOISTING INCIDENT

Holding the view that the flag hoisting
on April 19 had the character of a demonstration, the
authorities of the French Concession despatched a large
number of detectives and policemen to call at various
shops and to compel them to lower the flags. Some
misunderstanding arose in the course of which about 30
to 40 shop assistants were arrested and a number of
Chinese national flags taken away to the police stations.
This angered the shop keepers who then closed their
business.

Yesterday morning the suspension of
business was nearly general throughout the French
Concession when it became known that the negotiations
had no result as yet.

A survey made by our reporter revealed
that with the exception of foreign-owned shops,
restaurants and teashops, most of the large stores on
Rue du Consulat, Avenue Joffre, Avenue Dubail, Avenue
Foch, Rue Brenier Montmorand, Rue Pere Robert, Route des
Soeurs, Rue Porte de l'Ouest, Rue du Marche, Rue Lafayette,
etc., were on strike, but order was maintained. Strict
precautionary measures were adopted by the French Police
and parties of additional detectives and policemen were
patrolling the streets.

On the night of April 19, Mr. Ching Ding-
sung (金廷蓀 ), Acting Chairman of the Chinese Rate-
payers' Association of the French Concession, invited
the Chinese councillors and committeemen of the French
Municipal Council, including Messrs. Chang Yih-chu
(張翼樞 ) and Jui Chung-hwa (瞿振華 ), to a meeting
to discuss measures to deal with the affair. The
meeting expressed regret over the interference with the
flag hoisting and appointed Messrs. Jui Chung-hwa, Tai
Tsung-foong (戴春風 ) and Chuin Zing-ngan (龔靜岩 )
to call on the French Police to deal with the confiscation
of flags and the arrest of shop assistants.

At 10 a.m. yesterday the three represen-
tatives called at French Police Headquarters to request
an interview with the Commissioner. They were received
by Mr. Jobez, Deputy Commissioner. After expressing
the views of the merchants, the three representatives
presented the following three requests :-
(1) The immediate release of all arrested
persons.
(2) The return by the French Police of
the confiscated flags.
(3) Freedom to hoist flags on anniversary
days and the hope that the French Police will not inter-
fere again.

Mr. Jobez declared that he would transmit
the requests to the Commissioner and that a reply would
be given at 3 p.m. the same day.

1939年4月21日。
晨间译稿

《申报》及其他本地报纸：-

升旗事件

法租界当局认为4月19日的升旗活动具有示威性质，遂派遣大量侦探和警察前往各家商店，强迫其降下旗帜。在此过程中发生了一些误会，约有三四十名店员被捕，多面中国国旗被带往各警察局。此举激怒了店主，他们随即停止营业。

昨日上午，随着消息传开，称谈判迄今未有结果，法租界内几乎普遍停业。

本报记者调查发现，除外商拥有的商店、餐馆和茶室外，领事馆路（Rue du Consulat）、霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）、杜巴伊路（Avenue Dubail）、福煦路（Avenue Foch）、白尔尼埃蒙莫朗路（Rue Brenier Montmorand）、佩雷罗贝尔路（Rue Pere Robert）、修女路（Route des Soeurs）、西门路（Rue Porte de l'Ouest）、市场路（Rue du Marche）、辣斐德路（Rue Lafayette）等处的各大商号大多罢工，但秩序尚佳。法国警方采取了严格的预防措施，增派的侦探和警察分队在街道上巡逻。

4月19日晚，法租界华人纳税会代理主席金廷蓀先生邀请法国公董局的华籍董事及委员，包括张翼樞先生和瞿振華先生，举行会议，讨论处理此事的措施。会议对干涉升旗表示遗憾，并指派瞿振華、戴春風和龔靜岩三位先生去拜访法国警方，处理没收旗帜和逮捕店员一事。

昨日上午10时，这三位代表前往法国警察总局，要求会见总监。他们由副总监乔贝兹（Jobez）先生接见。三位代表表达了商界的观点后，提出了以下三项请求：-
(1) 立即释放所有被捕人员。
(2) 法国警方归还被没收的旗帜。
(3) 在纪念日享有升旗自由，并希望法国警方不再进行干涉。

乔贝兹先生表示，他将把这些请求转达给总监，并于当日下午3时给予答复。

April 21, 1939.
Morning Translation

At 3 p.m. the three representatives called again and after a discussion with Commissioner Fabre the following measures were agreed upon :-
(1) All the arrested persons will be released.
(2) The Chinese Ratepayers' Association will send a letter asking for the return of the flags detained by the Police.
(3) As the request for non-interference with the freedom of the residents to hoist flags does not lie within the jurisdiction of the Police, the request should be made to the French Consul-General.

As the arrested men had been released and as they had received notices from the Chamber of Commerce and the Chinese Ratepayers' Association advising them to resume business, the shops on Rue du Consulat and Avenue Joffre at 4 p.m. yesterday re-opened their doors. A number of committeemen of the Chinese Ratepayers' Association called personally at various shops to advise them to resume business. As the hour was already late, some stores remained closed. It is expected that all shops will resume business this morning.

According to investigations made by a reporter of the Sing Sung News Agency (新声通讯社), in all 36 persons including shop proprietors, assistants and residents were arrested by the Police during the incident on April 19. The number of persons injured cannot be ascertained. According to information given out by the French Police, an Annamite policeman and a Chinese policeman were injured in the face.
The arrested men were released at about 4 p.m. yesterday. It is understood that during their detention at the Police Station most of the men had refused to eat. However, the Police at first refused to release two of the arrested men because they had shouted and chalked slogans, but after strenuous negotiations they were expelled from the Concession.

As the Land Bank of China and some other banks in the French Concession were also involved in the flag incident on April 19, the Shanghai Bankers Association yesterday held a meeting at which it was resolved to console the banks concerned and to advise them to resume business pending negotiations by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the National Government and other public bodies concerned to secure a settlement. The various banks accepted the sincere advice of their Association and resumed business.

It is learned that the licence of the Crystal Palace Theatre (黄金大戏院), which has been withdrawn, has been returned and that the theatre will resume business to-day.
pages.zh:
1939年4月21日。
晨间译稿

下午3时，三位代表再次前往，在与法布尔（Fabre）总监讨论后，达成了以下措施：-
(1) 所有被捕人员将被释放。
(2) 华人纳税会将致函要求警方归还扣留的旗帜。
(3) 由于不干涉居民升旗自由的请求不在警方管辖范围内，该请求应向法国总领事提出。

由于被捕人员已被释放，且他们已收到商会和华人纳税会的通知，劝其复业，昨日下午4时，领事馆路和霞飞路的商店重新开门营业。华人纳税会的多名委员亲自前往各家商店，劝其复业。由于时间已晚，部分商店仍关门停业。预计所有商店将于今晨恢复营业。

据《新声通讯社》记者调查，在4月19日的事件中，共有36人包括店主、店员和居民被警方逮捕。受伤人数无法确定。据法国警方发布的信息，一名安南（越南）警察和一名中国警察面部受伤。
被捕人员于昨日下午4时左右获释。据悉，在被拘留于警察局期间，大多数人拒绝进食。然而，警方起初拒绝释放其中两名被捕者，因为他们曾高呼口号并用粉笔书写标语，但经过激烈谈判后，他们被驱逐出租界。

由于中国银行及法租界内其他一些银行也卷入了4月19日的升旗事件，上海银行公会昨日召开会议，决议慰问有关银行，并劝其在国民政府外交部及其他有关公共团体进行谈判以寻求解决期间恢复营业。各家银行接受了公会的诚恳建议，恢复了营业。

获悉，此前被吊销执照的黄金大戏院（Crystal Palace Theatre）已获发还执照，该院将于今日恢复营业。

April 21,1939.    Morning Translation.

Ta Mei Pao and other local newspapers :-

Declaration Issued by Lone Battalion Commander

In connection with the interference with
the hoisting of the national flag by the French
Concession authorities, Colonel Zia Tsing-yuan, Commander
of the Lone Battalion, issued the following declaration
yesterday :-
"With all sincerity I make a further
appeal to my fellow countrymen in Shanghai. The
sufferings we are undergoing to-day are only temporary.
All such unpleasantness will be removed after our glorious
victory. I therefore sincerely hope that my fellow
countrymen in Shanghai will assume a share of the
responsibility for the salvation of our country and
contribute as much as possible either in money or by
means of labour and to work strenuously and painstakingly."

Morning Leader and other local newspapers :-

Shop Owners in French Concession to Submit Statement
To French Ambassador

From 6.30 to 7.30 p.m. April 22, a banquet
will be given by the French Club, French Concession,
to M. Henri Cosme, the French Ambassador to China. During
the function the position of the French citizens in
China will be made clear to the Ambassador.
M. Henri Cosme arrived at Chungking on
March 5 and presented his credentials to Chairman Lin
Sen of the National Government and visited General Chiang
Kai-shek and Wang Chung-wei, Minister of Foreign Affairs.
This is the second time that M. Henri Cosme has visited
China. He has done much to promote friendly relations
with the Chinese Government and has expressed an assurance
that "a bright day will surely come to China."
Unfortunately, however, a regrettable
incident has taken place not long after M. Cosme's arrival
in Shanghai. The authorities of the French Concession
despatched police officers to interfere with the hoisting
of the national flag within the Concession and this gave
rise to a temporary suspension of business by all the
shops in the Concession. Such an incident is certainly
not desired by the French Ambassador and it is hoped that
it will not be repeated in future.
It is learned that the shops in the
French Concession are submitting a joint petition to
the French Ambassador to the above effect.

Ta Mei Wan Pao dated April 20 (Chungking telegram) :-

Chungking to Open Negotiations

Public circles in Chungking are paying
particular attention to the interference with the
hoisting of the national flag by the French Concession
authorities in Shanghai and have expressed profound
regret over the action of the French authorities. The
Government will soon take the matter up with the French
authorities through diplomatic channels so as to bring
about a reasonable settlement of this affair. It is
hoped that the people in Shanghai will wait calmly for
the result of the negotiations to be conducted by the
Government.

1939年4月21日。    晨间译稿。

《大美报》及其他本地报纸：-

孤军指挥官发表宣言

针对法租界当局干涉悬挂国旗一事，孤军指挥官谢晋元上校昨日发表如下宣言：
“我谨向上海同胞再次发出诚挚呼吁。我们目前所遭受的痛苦只是暂时的。在我们取得光荣胜利之后，所有这些不快都将消除。因此，我真诚希望上海同胞能分担救国责任，尽可能在金钱或劳力方面做出贡献，并刻苦努力地工作。”

《导报》及其他本地报纸：-

法租界店主将向法国大使提交陈述书

4月22日晚6时30分至7时30分，法租界法国总会将宴请法国驻华大使亨利·科斯梅（Henri Cosme）先生。在此期间，将向大使阐明在华法国公民的处境。
亨利·科斯梅先生于3月5日抵达重庆，向国民政府林森主席递交了国书，并拜访了蒋介石将军和外交部长王宠惠。这是亨利·科斯梅先生第二次访华。他为促进与中国的友好关系做了大量工作，并保证“中国必将迎来光明的日子”。
然而不幸的是，在科斯梅先生抵达上海后不久，发生了一起令人遗憾的事件。法租界当局派遣警察干涉租界内悬挂国旗的行为，导致租界内所有商店暂时停业。此类事件显然非法国大使所愿，希望今后不再重演。
据悉，法租界内的商店正在向法国大使提交一份联合请愿书，内容如上所述。

4月20日《大美晚报》（重庆电）：-

重庆将开启谈判

重庆各界特别关注上海法租界当局干涉悬挂国旗一事，并对法国当局的行动表示深切遗憾。政府即将通过外交渠道与法国当局交涉此事，以便合理解决这一事件。希望上海民众冷静等待政府谈判的结果。

SHANGHAI EVENING POST & MERCURY.
APR 20 1939
Chinese Stores
Shut To Protest
FMP Flag Action
Delegates Visit Fabre
Requesting Release
Of Prisoners
POLICE SUSPEND
THEATRE PERMIT
Main Streets Deserted
As Shops Declare
Virtual Strike
The Chinese Chamber of Commerce this afternoon issued an order requesting all shops in the French Concession to resume business immediately and wait for the outcome of the amicable negotiations to settle the dispute. The three delegates were to visit the police headquarters again this afternoon to continue their negotiations.
Practically all larger Chinese shops on the main thoroughfares in the French Concession are closed today in a virtual general strike to protest the seizure of Chinese national flags and arrest of scores of Chinese shop-keepers by French Municipal Police yesterday.
Three delegates of Chinese business circles in Frenchtown, Messrs. Tai Ching-feng, Ju Tseng-hua and Chung Ching-say, this morning called on Major L. Fabre,
FIVE MORE ARRESTED
Five Chinese were taken into custody by French police at noon today on charges of visiting various Chinese shops in the French Concession and asking them to close their doors.
Many handbills, requesting all business establishments to take "concerted action" in the fight to "regain the dignity of the national flag", were also found on the streets.
commissioner of the F.M.P., at his Rue Stanislas Chevallier headquarters and appealed for the release of Chinese, declared to number 30 to 40, who are still detained by police as result of the clashes yesterday.
No Decision
According to official information from the police headquarters, no decision was reached in the conference. It is stated at Chinese circles, however, that Major Fabre asked the Chinese business leaders to use their influence in securing the reopening of the shops before he would consider the release of the arrested men. Major Fabre subsequently visited the French Consulate-General.
While many shops are closed today in what is termed a spontaneous demonstration against the seizure of national flags, the Crystal Palace, Frenchtown's largest Peking opera theatre at the corner of Ru du Consulat and Boulevard de Montigny, had to suspend performances as from yesterday afternoon when the police authorities indefinitely suspended its permit following a clash outside the amusement center. Up to noon today, the permit has not been reinstated.

《上海晚邮报与信使报》
1939年4月20日
中国商店
关闭以抗议
法租界警务处
对国旗的行动
代表拜访法布尔
请求释放
囚犯
警方暂停
剧院执照
主要街道空无一人
因商店宣布
变相罢工
中国商会今天下午发布命令，要求法租界内所有商店立即恢复营业，并等待友好谈判解决争端的结果。三位代表将于今天下午再次前往警察总局，继续谈判。
今天，法租界主要干道上几乎所有较大的中国商店都关闭，进行变相的全面罢工，以抗议昨天法租界警务处没收中国国旗和逮捕数十名中国店主的行为。
法租界华商界的三位代表，戴清峰（音译）、茹振华（音译）和钟静斋（音译）先生，今天上午在斯坦尼斯拉斯·舍瓦利埃路（Rue Stanislas Chevallier）的总部拜访了法租界警务处总监L.法布尔少校，
又捕五人
今天中午，五名中国人被法国警察拘留，罪名是走访法租界内的各家中国商店，要求它们关门停业。
街上还发现许多传单，要求所有商业机构在“挽回国旗尊严”的斗争中采取“一致行动”。
并呼吁释放据称仍有三四十人被警方因昨天的冲突而拘留的中国人。
未作决定
据警察总局的官方消息，会议未达成任何决定。然而，据华人圈子称，法布尔少校要求中国商界领袖利用其影响力确保商店重新开业，然后他才会考虑释放被捕人员。随后，法布尔少校拜访了法国总领事馆。
虽然今天许多商店关闭，这被称为反对没收国旗的自发示威，但位于领事馆路和蒙蒂尼大道（Boulevard de Montigny）拐角处、法租界最大的京剧剧院黄金大戏院，不得不从昨天下午起暂停演出，因为娱乐中心外发生冲突后，警方当局无限期暂停了其执照。截至今天中午，执照尚未恢复。

pages.en:
Shutters Up
Both Avenue Joffre and Rue du
Consulat showed a conspicuous
absence of their usual bristling
activities this morning, with most
of the Chinese shop fronts covered
by shutters. Only smaller
establishments dealing in daily
necessities remained half-open
while the banks closed their front
entrances and requested their
customers to use the rear entrance.
At several of the Chinese jewel
stores, the show-windows, covered
by iron grills, were emptied for
fear of possible disturbances. Extra
police parties are patrolling the
streets.
The Avenue Joffre branch of
the Land Bank of China, scene
of one of the clashes yesterday,
was guarded by three constables
this morning. It is alleged that
the police refused to allow the
bank to reopen although they did
not stop customers entering by
the rear door.
Early this afternoon, French
police posted proclamations on
the telephone poles on the main
thoroughfares reiterating the ban
against political demonstrations.
"National flags may only be dis-
played on the national days," the
police ordered. All agitators are
warned.
During the numerous clashes
yesterday, none of which was
fortunately very serious, one
Chinese policeman and an Anna-
mite constable of the F.M.P. are
understood to have been set upon
by mobs and injured. The num-
ber of Chinese civilians injured
could not be ascertained although
it is understood more than 10
complained of injuries.
Fine Said Paid
According to Chinese reports,
around 100 arrests were made yes-
terday and many Chinese flags
seized by the French police. One
of the arrested man, who paid
a fine of $10 for his own freedom,
reported seized flags piled high
in the police station on Rue
Stanislas Chevalier.
The suspension of the Crystal
Palace permit followed a mob
scene outside of the theatre at
11 o'clock yesterday morning.
The theatre was ordered to re-
move the national flag. As soon
as the order was complied with,
telephone complaints were receiv-
ed from unknown sources describ-
ing themselves as "patriotic
citizens." Fearing trouble, the
theatre again hoisted the flag.
Officers Booed
Police arrived and seized the
emblem. A crowd gathered out-
side the theatre and booed the
officers. Among the demonstra-
tors, police allege, were employees
of the theatre. The allegation,
however, was denied by the
theatre management who con-
tends that there were only three
booking office officials inside the
theatre at the time. All of them
were subsequently taken to the
station.
The theatre was allowed to pro-
ceed with the first matinee cinema
performance but not allowed to
give the second performance which
was to start at 4 and the night
performance of Peiping opera at
7.30 p.m.
Meanwhile, the local observance
of the launching of the Spiritual
Mobilization Movement, for which
the Chinese national flags were
displayed yesterday, was con-
tinued today. The Shanghai com-
mittee of the movement today is-
sued circulars to students asking
them to join the mobilization
ordered by General Chiang Kai-
shek.
pages.zh:
店铺关门

今晨，霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）和领事馆路（Rue du Consulat）往日熙熙攘攘的景象明显消失，大多数中国店铺的店面都用百叶窗遮挡。只有经营日常必需品的小店铺半开着门，而银行则关闭了正门，要求顾客使用后门进出。出于对可能发生骚乱的担忧，几家中国珠宝店的橱窗在铁栅栏的防护下已被清空。额外的警察小队正在街道上巡逻。

昨天发生冲突地点之一的中国银行霞飞路分行，今晨由三名巡捕看守。据称，警方拒绝允许银行重新开门营业，尽管他们并未阻止顾客从后门进入。

今天下午早些时候，法国警察在主要干道的电线杆上张贴告示，重申禁止政治示威的命令。“国旗仅可在国庆日悬挂，”警方命令道。所有煽动者均受到警告。

在昨天的多次冲突中，所幸没有一次非常严重，据悉有一名中国警察和一名法租界警务处（F.M.P.）的安南籍巡捕遭到暴徒袭击并受伤。受伤的中国平民人数无法确定，但据悉有超过10人投诉受伤。

罚款已缴

据中文报道，昨天约有100人被捕，许多中国国旗被法国警察没收。其中一名被捕男子缴纳了10美元罚款以获得自由，他报告说，在斯塔尼斯拉斯·谢瓦利埃路（Rue Stanislas Chevalier）的警察局里，被没收的旗帜堆积如山。

水晶宫剧院许可证被暂停，起因是昨天上午11点剧院外发生了一起聚众闹事事件。剧院被命令撤下国旗。一旦遵令执行，便接到来自自称“爱国公民”的不明来源的电话投诉。因担心惹出麻烦，剧院再次升起了国旗。

警官遭嘘

警察赶到并没收了该标志。一群人在剧院外聚集，向警官发出嘘声。警方指控，示威者中有剧院的员工。然而，这一指控遭到剧院管理方的否认，他们辩称当时剧院内只有三名售票处职员。随后，这些人全部被带往警察局。

剧院获准继续进行第一场日场电影放映，但不允许举行原定于下午4点开始的第二场放映以及晚上7点半的京剧夜场演出。

与此同时，昨天为展示中国国旗而举行的“精神总动员运动”发起仪式的地方纪念活动今天仍在继续。该运动的上海委员会今天向学生发布通告，要求他们加入蒋介石将军下令进行的动员。

SHANGHAI EVENING POST & MERCURY.
APR 20 1939

The Readers'
Forum

Seizure Of Flags
The Editor,
SHANGHAI EVENING POST,
Dear Editor,
One thing striking me seriously
this morning is the raising of the
national flag in the Concession.
Today, you may know, we Chinese
are celebrating the occasion of
Spiritual Movement which was
advocated by Chiang Kai-shek by
raising the national flag. But
unfortunately, the French Police
intervened and insisted on hauling
down our national flag. Despite
mild interpretation and protest,
the French Police forcibly seized
all the flags flying from the top
of every business house. I hope
your third party nation comes out
as arbiter of justice for the wel-
fare of China.
Yours truly,
P. H. W.
April 19, 1939.

1939年4月20日

致编辑：
《上海晚邮报》

亲爱的编辑：

今晨令我深感震惊的一件事是，在租界内升起国旗。如您所知，今天我们中国人正在通过升起国旗来庆祝由蒋介石倡导的“精神运动”。但不幸的是，法国警察进行干预，坚持要降下我们的国旗。尽管我们进行了温和的解释和抗议，法国警察还是强行没收了悬挂在每家商铺顶部的所有旗帜。我希望贵国作为第三方国家，为了中国的福祉，出面担任正义的仲裁者。

此致

F. M. P. Bars
Hoisting Of
Chinese Flags

Many Shops Closed In
Fear Of Trouble In
Concession

OFFICERS CLASH
WITH SHOPKEEPERS

Several Men Detained
For Questioning
On Affrays

Chinese shops on Rue du Consulat and other main Frenchtown thoroughfares boarded up their premises and partially ceased business transactions yesterday afternoon following a series of incidents in which Concession police asked the shopkeepers to remove the Chinese national flag.

The tri-color Chinese national emblem was being displayed throughout the city yesterday to commemorate the inauguration of the Spiritual Mobilization Movement here.

Up to a late hour last night, the situation remained at a deadlock. It was stated, however, that no new development was expected today and that the Frenchtown shops may resume business this morning.

Men Detained

On several occasions, throughout the day, employees in the Chinese establishments were reported to have openly resisted the police, resulting in the detention of a number of men for questioning.

In an official statement to the press last night French Police authorities indicated that they considered the hoisting of the Chinese flags on this particular day as being a political manifestation which, in order to preserve the Concession's absolute neutrality, is not being allowed by the authorities.

The first incident occurred at Avenue Joffre branch of the Land Bank of China where four bank employees were injured and some property damaged during an affray between the employees and the police.

Another fist fight with the officers who had come to tell the shopowner not to hoist the Chinese flag was reported at a Chinese dry goods store on Rue du Consulat.

According to eye-witness reports, the flag attached to a bamboo pole was in the hands of an employee. A Russian officer rushed to the door, and after grabbing the flag from the Chinese, broke the bamboo pole into two. He tore the flag in the same process.

Reports of these incidents spread quickly throughout the business sections of Frenchtown, resulting in the closure of the shops.

法租界警务处禁止
悬挂中国国旗

因担心租界内发生麻烦
许多店铺关闭

警官与店主发生冲突

数人因斗殴事件
被拘留问话

昨天下午，在领事馆路和其他法租界主要干道上的中国店铺将店面用木板封住，并部分停止营业，此前发生了一系列事件，租界警察要求店主移除中国国旗。

昨天，全市各地悬挂三色中国国徽，以纪念在此发起的“精神总动员运动”。

直到昨晚深夜，局势仍处于僵持状态。不过，据说今天预计不会有新的发展，法租界的店铺可能于今晨恢复营业。

人员被拘留

据报道，全天数次发生中国商号员工公开抗拒警察的情况，导致多人被拘留问话。

法国警察当局昨晚向新闻界发表正式声明，表示他们认为在这一特定日子悬挂中国国旗属于政治表现，为维护租界的绝对中立，当局不予允许。

第一起事件发生在中国银行霞飞路分行，员工与警察发生斗殴，导致四名银行员工受伤，部分财产受损。

另一起事件发生在领事馆路的一家中国百货店，店员与前来告知店主不得悬挂中国国旗的警官发生了拳脚冲突。

据目击者报告，一面系在竹竿上的旗帜掌握在一名员工手中。一名俄国籍警官冲到门口，从中国人手中夺过旗帜，并将竹竿折成两段。在此过程中，他将旗帜撕碎。

这些事件的报道迅速传遍法租界的商业区，导致店铺关门。

（批注：81/2 4月21日. Lile C%）

pages.en:
Police Remove Flags
On several occasions, when shop
employees refused to take down
the flags as ordered by the police,
the officers were said to have re-
moved them themselves. Some of
the flags thus removed were given
back to the owners while others
were taken by the police to the
station.
This occurred at the shop of the
Tai Hong Company on Rue du
Consulat at 1:30 in the afternoon.
The officers walked away with the
flag after removing it from the
pole.
The same incident occurred at a
Chinese store on Avenue Edward
VII when an Annamite constable
walked away with the Chinese flag
tucked under his arm.
On Sun Yat-sen's birthday on
March 12, the same order was is-
sued by the French police barring
the flying of any Chinese national
flag in the Concession. The reason
given for the measure on that oc-
casion was identical with that is-
sued yesterday.
The ban in Frenchtown not-
withstanding, Chinese national flags
were hoisted in the Settlement
yesterday to mark the inauguration
of the National Spiritual Mobiliza-
tion drive in the city.

Message Sent
The observance of the day was
begun with the sending of a tele-
gram to Generalissimo Chiang Kai-
shek by the National Spiritual
Mobilization League here con-
gratulating him on the reported
successes of the general military
counter-offensive.
Reiterating their loyalty members
of the League again pledged to
the Chinese Leader that "Chinese
in Shanghai have placed all their
manpower and material resources
behind the national war of re-
sistance."
Meanwhile, a circular wire to the
Chinese people by the same group
was released to the Chinese press
yesterday. The message urged the
people to stand behind the Gen-
eralissimo in the prosecution of the
war and emphasized the importance
of national unity in the struggle.
While expressing their convic-
tion that China will achieve final
victory, the League stated that "we
must prepare for greater suffering
as the day of triumph draws closer."
Both telegrams were signed by
the agricultural, commercial and
industrial branches of the League
in this city.
According to Chinese sources, the
organization of the League was
effected in accordance with the
order issued by the Generalissimo.
The last branch of the League to
complete its organization was the
Agricultural branch which was
inaugurated on Monday.
pages.zh:
警察移除旗帜

据报道，在几次事件中，当店铺员工拒绝按警察命令取下旗帜时，警官便亲自将其移除。一些这样被移除的旗帜归还给了业主，而另一些则被警察带回警局。

下午1点30分，这种情况发生在领事馆路的泰洪公司（Tai Hong Company，音译）店铺。警官将旗帜从旗杆上取下后带走。

同样的事件发生在爱德华七世大道（Avenue Edward VII）的一家中国商店，一名安南籍巡捕夹着中国国旗离开。

在3月12日孙中山诞辰纪念日，法国警察曾发布同样的命令，禁止在租界内悬挂任何中国国旗。当时采取这一措施的理由与昨天发布的理由相同。

尽管法租界实施了禁令，昨天公共租界内仍升起了中国国旗，以纪念本市“国民精神总动员”运动的发起。

发送电文

当天的纪念活动始于本地“国民精神总动员联盟”向蒋介石总司令发送贺电，祝贺其在全面军事反攻中据报取得的胜利。

联盟成员重申忠诚，再次向中国领袖保证：“上海华人已将全部人力和物力资源投入到民族抗战之中。”

与此同时，该团体发给中国人民的通函电报昨天发布给中文媒体。该电文敦促人民支持总司令进行战争，并强调在斗争中国家统一的重要性。

联盟在表达对中国终将取得最后胜利的信念的同时，表示：“随着胜利日的临近，我们必须准备承受更大的苦难。”

两份电文均由该联盟在本市的农业、商业和工业分支签署。

据中方消息来源，该联盟的组织是依照总司令发布的命令建立的。最后完成组织工作的分支是农业分支，该分支于周一正式成立。

SHANGHAI TIMES.
APR 20 1939
French Police
Action Over
Flag Raising
Display Of National
Bunting By Chinese
Is Frowned Upon
ORDERS TO REMOVE
EMBLEMS ENFORCED
An atmosphere full of tension
prevailed in the French Con-
cession yesterday morning and
afternoon as squads of police
moved all over the Concession
requesting shopkeepers, office
managers and house owners to
lower the Chinese National
flags which had been hoisted
outside their buildings.
Although most of those approach-
ed took down the flags as requested,
several scuffles along Rue du Con-
sulat and along Avenue Joffre were
reported to have taken place
between the police and Chinese who
refused to obey the instructions.
Armoured cars and large squads
of police operated along Avenue
Joffre and other thoroughfares
early yesterday afternoon, although
officials of the French Police claimed
that everything was normal and
that no clashes had occurred.
Several Chinese shops in the
Concession were reported to have
closed their doors as a protest
against the action taken by the
French Police in prohibiting the
flying of national flags.
Settlement Normal
While this was going on in the
French Concession, everything was
reported to be normal in the Inter-
national Settlement. No action
against the display of flags was
taken by the Shanghai Municipal
Police.
The seizure of flags by officers of
the French Police, after they had
allegedly forcibly pulled them down,
was emphatically denied by the
French Police authorities.
Clash Reported
A rather serious clash between
police officers and officials of the
Land Bank of China, on Avenue
Joffre, was reported to have
occurred just before noon. It was
alleged that officers had gained
entrance into the building by force
and had pulled down the national
flag and taken it away with them
after allegedly having used a baton
on the bank employees. This re-
port was also denied by an official
of the French Police.
Reason For Display
Of Flags
In compliance with instructions
from the Chinese National Gov-
ernment in Chungking, there was
inaugurated by some members of
the local Chinese community yes-
terday what is known as the
"national spiritual mobilization
week," commemorating the occa-
sion with the hoisting of Kuomin-
tang flags.

1939年4月20日
法国警察
因升旗采取行动
中国人展示
国旗之举
遭当局不满
移除标志之命令
得到执行
昨天上午和下午，法租界内弥漫着紧张的气氛，多队警察遍布租界各地，要求店主、办事处经理和房主降下悬挂在建筑物外的中国国旗。
虽然大多数被劝导者按要求取下了旗帜，但据报在领事馆路（Rue du Consulat）和霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）沿线，警察与拒绝服从指令的中国人之间发生了几起小规模冲突。
昨天下午早些时候，装甲车和大批警察在霞飞路及其他主要干道上行动，尽管法国警方官员声称一切正常，未发生任何冲突。
据报，租界内的几家中国商店为抗议法国警察禁止悬挂国旗的行动而关门停业。
公共租界情况正常
当法租界发生上述事件时，据报国际公共租界内一切正常。上海公共租界工部局警务处未对展示旗帜的行为采取任何行动。
法国警方当局坚决否认其警员在 allegedly 强行扯下旗帜后予以没收的说法。
据报道发生冲突
据报，中午前不久，在霞飞路的中国农民银行（Land Bank of China）警员与该银行职员之间发生了较为严重的冲突。据称，警员强行进入大楼，扯下国旗并带走，且 allegedly 对银行员工使用了警棍。法国警方一名官员也否认了这一报道。
展示旗帜的原因
为响应重庆中国国民政府的指示，本地华人社区部分成员于昨日启动了所谓的“国民精神总动员周”，并通过悬挂国民党旗帜来纪念这一时刻。

pages.en:
On the other hand, usually reliable
Chinese reports stated that execu-
tives of the Land Bank of China
held an emergency conference at
the Bankers Association, 59, Hong-
kong Road, shortly after the incid-
ents, which was said to have in-
volved four staff members of the
bank who were injured in a clash
with French police.
It was decided at the meeting to
wire the Chungking Government
for instructions, it was learnt last
night.
Uniforms Found
A squad of Japanese gendarmerie,
accompanied by Settlement police,
visited the godown premises of the
Land Bank of China on North
Soochow Road at about 11.30 o'clock
yesterday morning.
No one was reported to have been
arrested. Instead the party found
stored up in the godown between
2,600 to 3,000 brand new Chinese
uniforms, which had been mortgag-
ed to the bank, according to re-
ports yesterday afternoon.
A Cantonese shop on Route Voyron
stoutly opposed French police at-
tempts to bring the flag down, Chin-
ese reports stated yesterday. Spec-
tators came flocking to the scene
of dispute, and shouted at the French
police. Finally, a French sergeant
came to the scene and mediated.
Flags were taken down from the
Wei Hsin Universal Goods Store in
Route Porte de l'Ouest and from
other shop-houses in Rue Brenier
de Montmorand. The shop-keepers
resisted attempts to take the flags
down. An assistant of the Wei Hsin
Universal Goods stores was arrested
and taken to the police station.
All the shops closed their doors
as a protest against the "interfer-
ence." All shops on Avenue Edward
VII, Rue Eugene Bard, Rue
Lafayette, Avenue Joffre and Rue du
Consulat, also followed suit in pro-
test by closing their doors.
Shortly after the series of inci-
dents on Rue du Consulat, slogans
written on the walls and pavements
appeared, written in chalk, declar-
ing "We fight for justice," etc.
The French police threw a cordon
around the side streets on both sides
of Rue du Consulat as a precaution
against any untoward incident. The
police patrols were later reinforced,
and armoured cars were also in
evidence.
Official Statement
According to the French Police
last night, "no serious incidents" oc-
curred in the Concession during the
day. As the general raising of flags
assumed the appearance of a
political manifestation, "residents
were invited to lower the flags and
this decision did not provoke one
demonstration."
In this connection, the French
Concession authorities have issued
the following notice:—
"The French authorities remind
the population that political demons-
trations, no matter of what sort,
continue to be absolutely forbidden
in the Concession. These demons-
trations are evidently provoked by
agitators with the object of creating
troubles prejudicial to public order
and safety. The French authorities,
while respecting the sentiments of
all, have had to take the measures
which they are imposing in order
to assure the absolute neutrality of
the Concession and the tranquillity
of its residents. They will expel if
necessary the agitators.
"In particular, the mass raising of
flags, assuming the character of a
political demonstration, is forbidden,
except on the occasion of the Na-
tional Holiday."
pages.zh:
另一方面，通常可靠的中方消息来源称，事件发生后不久，中国农民银行的高管们在香港路59号的银行公会召开了一次紧急会议，据说有四名银行职员在与法国警察的冲突中受伤。
据悉，昨晚得知，会议决定致电重庆政府请示指示。
发现制服
昨天上午11时30分左右，一队日本宪兵在公共租界警察的陪同下，视察了中国农民银行位于北苏州路的仓库 premises。
据报无人被捕。相反，据昨天下午的报道，该队在仓库中发现了2,600至3,000套崭新的中国制服，这些制服已被抵押给该银行。
中方消息源昨天称，维荣路（Route Voyron）上一家广东籍商人开设的店铺强烈抵制法国警察试图降下旗帜的行为。围观群众涌向争议现场，并向法国警察呼喊。最后，一名法国警士赶到现场进行调解。
西门路（Route Porte de l'Ouest）的维新百货店（Wei Hsin Universal Goods Store）以及孟莫兰路（Rue Brenier de Montmorand）的其他商铺住宅上的旗帜被取下。店主们抵抗了取下旗帜的企图。维新百货店的一名助理被捕并被带往警察局。
所有商店均关门以示对“干涉”的抗议。爱德华七世路（Avenue Edward VII）、欧仁·巴尔路（Rue Eugene Bard）、辣斐德路（Rue Lafayette）、霞飞路和领事馆路上的所有商店也纷纷效仿，关门以示抗议。
在领事馆路发生一系列事件后不久，墙壁和人行道上出现了用粉笔书写的标语，宣称“我们为正义而战”等。
作为预防任何不幸事件的措施，法国警察在领事馆路两侧的支路上设置了警戒线。随后加强了巡逻警力，装甲车也出现在现场。
官方声明
根据法国警方昨晚的说法，当天租界内“未发生严重事件”。由于普遍升旗呈现出政治示威的外观，“居民被要求降下旗帜，而这一决定并未引发任何示威活动。”
就此，法租界当局发布了以下通告：—
“法国当局提醒民众，任何形式的政治示威在租界内继续被绝对禁止。这些示威显然是由煽动者挑起的，目的是制造有害于公共秩序和安全的麻烦。法国当局在尊重所有人情感的同时，不得不采取其所实施的措施，以确保租界的绝对中立及其居民的安宁。如有必要，他们将驱逐煽动者。
“特别是，除国庆日外，禁止具有政治示威性质的大规模升旗行为。”
