Telegram of Protest
A telegram was sent to the
Chungking Ministry of Foreign
Affairs by local Chinese public
bodies following the series of in-
cidents in the French Concession.
The telegram petitioned the For-
eign Ministry to take up with the
French authorities this "unfriendly"
action. It was also decided to dis-
patch a delegation to call on M.
Henri Cosme, the French Ambas-
sador to China, following a joint
conference of the various guilds,
according to Chinese reports.
pages.zh:
抗议电报
在法租界发生一系列事件后，本地华人公共团体向重庆外交部发送了一封电报。电报请求外交部就这一“不友好”行动与法国当局进行交涉。据中方报道，在各同业公会联合会议后，还决定派遣代表团拜访法国驻华大使亨利·科斯梅（Henri Cosme）先生。

pages.en:
NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS,
APR 20 1939
Chinese Resist
French Police
Hoisting of Chinese Flags
Forbidden in Concession ;
Shops Close in Protest
General excitement prevailed in
the French Concession yesterday as
Chinese shopkeepers insisted in dis-
playing Chinese national flags to
celebrate the launching of the
"spiritual mobilization movement"
which was started by General
Chiang Kai-shek early in the week.
When shops opened this morning
flags were put outside most of the
buildings on Rue du Consulat and
Ave. Joffre. Concession police were
faced with the task of removing
hundreds of flags which in many
cases were only replaced with new
ones.
Tempers ran exceptionally high
along Rue du Consulat and in
many cases patriotic Chinese showed
signs of resistance. It is reported
that a number of Chinese were
taken into custody and that at least
one Chinese policeman was injured
in a street clash. The report had
not been confirmed by police au-
thorities up to a late hour last
night.
The Ave. Joffre branch of the
China Land Bank was the focus of
considerable activity about 11.20
a.m. when employees of the bank,
after refusing to lower the flags
which were displayed from the
second floor locked the doors of the
building so that police could not
enter. Police succeeded, however, in
breaking the glass in a back door
and thus gained entrance, only to
meet with resistance from the
occupants. According to the story
of one employee, police used their
clubs freely and three "patriots"
received a number of blows on the
head and shoulders. In the words
of a clerk who is employed by the
firm, "China and France are friends
and we could see no reason why
we should take down our national
flag when we were living in friendly
territory. If France recognizes our
government, she must recognize our
flag."
Shops Remain Closed
The trouble is reported to have
started at about 11 yesterday morn-
ing, and, although police had suc-
ceeded in removing all flags by
noon, tension continued to run high
throughout the afternoon. The
majority of the shops along Rue du
Consulat remained closed during
the day and irate shopkeepers were
refusing to open their doors until
they were allowed to display flags.
It would appear that trouble occurred
only in cases where police, in their
efforts to facilitate removal of
national emblems, accidentally tore
or dropped the flags, and onlookers
too quickly drew the conclusion that
police were undertaking willful
damage.
French Concession streets were
fairly quiet late yesterday after-
noon, and although numerous police
were still to be seen patrolling Rue
du Consulat and Ave. Joffre, the
crowds of interested spectators had
largely dispersed. Occasional small
groups of Chinese standing about
the doorways of closed shops gave
the only sign that any untoward
incidents had occurred.
pages.zh:
《华北每日新闻》，
1939年4月20日
中国人抵制
法国警察
租界内禁止悬挂中国国旗；
商店关门抗议
昨天，法租界内普遍出现激动情绪，因为中国店主坚持展示中国国旗，以庆祝由蒋介石将军在本周初发起的“精神总动员运动”。
今早商店开门时，领事馆路和霞飞路的大部分建筑物外都挂起了旗帜。租界警察面临着移除数百面旗帜的任务，而在许多情况下，旧旗刚被取下，新旗又被挂上。
领事馆路沿线的情绪异常高涨，在许多情况下，爱国的中国人表现出抵抗的迹象。据报道，多名中国人被拘留，至少有一名中国警察在街头冲突中受伤。直到昨晚很晚的时候，警方当局尚未证实这一报道。
上午11时20分左右，中国农民银行霞飞路分行成为大量活动的焦点，当时该银行员工拒绝降下二楼展示的旗帜，并锁上了大楼的门，以防警察进入。然而，警察成功打破了后门的玻璃从而进入，却遭到了屋内人员的抵抗。据一名员工讲述，警察随意使用警棍，三名“爱国者”的头部和肩部遭受了多次击打。用该行一名职员的话说：“中国和法国是朋友，我们看不出在友好的领土上生活有何理由要取下我们的国旗。如果法国承认我们的政府，她就必须承认我们的旗帜。”
商店保持关闭
据报道，麻烦始于昨天上午11时左右，虽然警察在中午前成功移除了所有旗帜，但整个下午紧张局势依然高涨。领事馆路沿线的大多数商店白天一直关门，愤怒的店主拒绝开门，除非允许他们展示旗帜。看来，麻烦仅发生在警察为便于移除国家标志而意外撕破或掉落旗帜的情况下，而旁观者过快得出了警察故意破坏的结论。
昨天傍晚，法租界街道相当安静，虽然仍可见众多警察在领事馆路和霞飞路巡逻，但好奇的围观人群已基本散去。偶尔有几小群中国人站在关闭的店铺门口，这是发生任何不幸事件的唯一迹象。

pages.en:
Population Organized
It is reported that Shanghai's
Chinese population is being organized
into groups all of which are re-
quired to take a special oath of
loyalty to the Chinese government
in Chungking, although the general
flag hoisting which took place yes-
terday is not supposed to have the
result of any order from the local
branch of the Kuomintang which,
according to some sources, is secretly
functioning in Shanghai.
pages.zh:
民众组织化
据报道，上海的中国民众正被组织成各个团体，所有团体都被要求宣誓效忠重庆的中国政府，尽管昨天发生的普遍升旗行为据信并非源于国民党上海地方分支的任何命令，据某些消息来源称，该分支在上海秘密运作。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. S. REGISTRY
No. S. R. D. 9133
Date

April 20, 1939
Morning Translation

Chinese-American Daily News, Standard, Shun Pao, Sin Wan Pao
and other local newspapers:-

"INCIDENT OVER HOISTING OF NATIONAL FLAG OCCURS IN FRENCH
CONCESSION: SHOPS SUSPEND BUSINESS AS PROTEST."

Yesterday being the propaganda day for peasants,
labourers and merchants of the People's Spiritual Mobilization
Propaganda Week, the industrial and commercial bodies in
this locality hoisted the national flag as a sign of their
observance of the movement and in celebration of the
victories won in the general offensive. Early yesterday
morning the Chinese national flag was displayed in every part
of the city.

In the International Settlement not a single untoward
incident occurred. In the French Concession, however, the
entire French Police Force was mobilized and took extra
precautionary measures. Policemen were detailed to interfere
with flag hoisting and this gave rise to unfortunate disputes
and several tens of persons were injured and arrested.
All the shops in busy thoroughfares, such as Rue du Consulat,
Boulevard de Montigny, Rue Eugene Bard, etc. closed their
doors.

Following the incident, various public bodies
despatched officials to console those shops which had been
interfered with; they also sent a joint telegram to the
Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the National Government
with a request that negotiations be opened with the French
authorities. At the same time, M. Henri Cosme, the French
Ambassador to China, was approached so that the matter
might be solved amicably.

Rue du Consulat

At 10 a.m. yesterday the French Police despatched
a large party of detectives and policemen to stop the shops
from hoisting the Chinese national flag. The shops refused
to comply with the order on the ground that the flag hoisting
did not constitute a violation of the Police regulations. As
a result disputes took place.

The first shop visited was the Dah Kwang Ming Under-
wear Company (大光明内衣公司), No.414 Rue du Consulat. A
party of policemen instructed the employees of the company
to lower the flag. When the company subsequently hoisted
it again, the Police again intervened.

By this time a crowd of pedestrians had collected
and some shouted: "Don't lower the flag." An Annamite
policeman then went to the upper part of the house and
lowered the flag, while Loh Mei-kiang (罗梅江), the
proprietor of the company, was taken away by the Police.
A young Chinese attempted to hoist the flag again and this
gave rise to a conflict with the Annamite policemen on duty
near the place. When the officers tried to take the Chinese
to the Police Station, members of the crowd declared that
they would go to the station together. Owing to language
difficulties, a fight took place. Upon receipt of a report,
the French Police despatched additional policemen and an
pages.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别巡捕房登记处
编号：S. R. D. 9133
日期

1939年4月20日
晨间译件

《中美日报》、《标准晚报》、《申报》、《新闻报》
及其他本地报纸：-

“法租界发生悬挂国旗事件：商店停业抗议。”

昨日是人民精神动员宣传周中针对农民、劳工和商人的宣传日，本地工商团体悬挂国旗，以示对该运动的响应并庆祝全面进攻中取得的胜利。昨日清晨，中国国旗在全市各地飘扬。

在国际租界（即公共租界），未发生任何意外事件。然而，在法租界，整个法国警察部队被动员起来，并采取了额外的预防措施。警察被派去干涉悬挂国旗的行为，这引发了不幸的争端，数十人受伤并被捕。领事馆路（Rue du Consulat）、蒙蒂尼大道（Boulevard de Montigny）、欧仁·巴尔路（Rue Eugene Bard）等繁忙街道上的所有商店均关门停业。

事件发生后，各公共团体派遣官员慰问受到干扰的商店；他们还向国民政府外交部发送了一份联合电报，请求与法国当局展开谈判。同时，也接触了法国驻华大使亨利·科斯梅（Henri Cosme）先生，以便和平解决此事。

领事馆路

昨日上午10时，法国警方派遣大批侦探和警察前往阻止商店悬挂中国国旗。商店以悬挂国旗并不违反警察规章为由，拒绝服从命令。结果发生了争执。

首先被造访的是位于领事馆路414号的大光明内衣公司。一队警察指示该公司员工降下国旗。当该公司随后再次升起国旗时，警方再次介入。

此时，一群行人聚集起来，有人高喊：“不要降旗。”一名安南籍警察随即登上房屋上部降下国旗，而该公司老板罗梅江则被警方带走。一名年轻中国人试图再次升旗，这与附近执勤的安南籍警察发生了冲突。当警官试图将该中国人带往警察局时，围观人群表示他们将一同前往警局。由于语言障碍，发生了斗殴。接到报告后，法国警方增派警察及一辆

pages.en:
April 20, 1939.
Morning Translation

armoured car to the place to disperse the crowd. Several
persons were injured in the course of the fight including
Chow Kwei-yuan (周奎源), Tai Keng-sun (戴更生), two employees
of the Dah Kwang Ming Underwear Company, and some Chinese and
Annamite policemen, but they were not taken to hospital owing
to the slight nature of their injuries.
Misunderstanding also arose over language difficulties
between the Police and several other shops in the vicinity
such as the Kwan Sun Yuen Branch Restaurant (冠生園支店), the
Tai Kong Biscuit and Candy Company (泰康公司) and others,
resulting in the arrest of several shop assistants.
At 1.30 p.m. the shops in the vicinity closed their
doors and their example was followed by other shops in the
western section of Rue du Consulat and on Boulevard de Montigny.

Avenue Joffre

The second incident occurred at the Land Bank of
China, No.543 Avenue Joffre. At about 11 a.m. officers of
the French Police posted on Avenue Joffre notified the shops
to lower the flag . The Land Bank of China refused to do so.
Subsequently an Inspector riding on a motor cycle arrived,
entered the bank and through a slip of the hand broke a pane
in the window leading to the staircase. The officer then went
to the upper part of the premises and removed the flag. Four
of the bank employees who argued with him were injured. Their
names are Ho Sz-niau (何士堯), Ho Yung-yee (何永義), Ho Chih-
yoong (何志榮) and Wong Hung-tsen (王鴻漸). A watchman
employed by the bank was also taken away.
In the meantime several other disputes were occurring
at the following places:
(1) The Ya Mei Kwei Candy Shop (野玫瑰糖果店) at the
corner of Avenue Joffre and Route Voyron. Here a fight took
place following an order from an Annamite policeman to lower
the flag. One person was arrested.
(2) A Chinese youth was put under arrest for writing
in white chalk the expression "Running dog" on an armoured car
stationed at the corner of Avenue Joffre and Route Voyron.
(3) A girl student was arrested for hoisting a flag
at the Wireless Supplementary School (無線電補習學校) on the 4th
floor of the Chung Hwa Vocational Educational Institute
(中華職業教育社) on Route Voyron.
(4) At the Kiangsu Farmers Bank (江蘇農民銀行) at
the corner of Route Voyron and Avenue Joffre.
(5) One of the assistants of the Tien Ziang Cigarette
Shop (天祥號烟廠), 521 Avenue Joffre, was arrested.
(5) A coolie of the Joint Savings Society (四行儲蓄會)
on Avenue Joffre was prevented by a Russian policeman from
hoisting the flag.

Boulevard de Montigny

The Crystal Palace Theatre (黃金大戲院) at the corner
of Rue Kraetzer and Boulevard de Montigny was interfered with
by the French Police for hoisting a flag. At noon when other
shops in the vicinity again hoisted the flag, the theatre did
likewise. At 2 p.m. Russian and Annamite policeman inter-
vened and removed the flag. Two members of the staff were
taken away. The management lodged a protest with the Police
but without result. At that time a motion picture was being
shown in the theatre but the show was stopped and the theatre
suspended its performance last night. The theatre will
suspend business to-day pending a settlement of the affair.
pages.zh:
1939年4月20日。
晨间译件

装甲车前往现场驱散人群。斗殴过程中数人受伤，包括大光明内衣公司的两名员工周奎源、戴更生，以及一些中国和安南籍警察，但因伤势轻微，他们未被送往医院。
由于语言障碍，警方与附近其他几家商店（如冠生园支店、泰康饼干糖果公司等）之间也产生了误会，导致几名店员被捕。
下午1时30分，附近商店关门停业，领事馆路西段和蒙蒂尼大道上的其他商店也纷纷效仿。

霞飞路

第二起事件发生在霞飞路543号的中国土地银行。上午11时许，驻守霞飞路的法国警察官员通知商店降下国旗。中国土地银行拒绝照办。随后，一名骑摩托车抵达的督察进入银行，因手滑打碎了通往楼梯的窗户玻璃。该警官随后前往楼上取下国旗。四名与其争辩的银行员工受伤。他们的名字是何士堯、何永義、何志榮和王鴻漸。银行雇用的一名看守也被带走。
与此同时，以下地点也发生了其他几起纠纷：
(1) 霞飞路与魏隆路（Route Voyron）交界处的野玫瑰糖果店。此处因一名安南籍警察下令降旗而发生斗殴。一人被捕。
(2) 一名中国青年因在停泊于霞飞路与魏隆路交界处的一辆装甲车上用白粉笔写下“走狗”一词而被捕。
(3) 一名女学生因在魏隆路中华职业教育社四楼的无线电补习学校悬挂国旗而被捕。
(4) 魏隆路与霞飞路交界处的江苏农民银行。
(5) 霞飞路521号天祥号烟厂的一名助手被捕。
(5) 霞飞路四行储蓄会的一名苦力被一名俄罗斯警察阻止悬挂国旗。

蒙蒂尼大道

位于克雷策路（Rue Kraetzer）与蒙蒂尼大道交界处的黄金大戏院因悬挂国旗受到法国警方的干涉。中午时分，当附近其他商店再次悬挂国旗时，戏院也照做。下午2时，俄罗斯和安南籍警察介入并取下了国旗。两名工作人员被带走。管理层向警方提出抗议，但未获结果。当时戏院内正在放映电影，但放映被迫停止，戏院昨晚暂停演出。在该事件得到解决之前，戏院今日将暂停营业。

pages.en:
April 20, 1939.
Morning Translation.

Rue Porte de l'Ouest

Disputes also occurred at 1 p.m. on Rue
Porte de l'Ouest near Rue du Marche when several shops
were ordered by the police to lower their flags. An
employee of the Vee Sing General Store (維新公司)
was arrested. As a consequence, other shops in the
vicinity suspended business.
The incident attracted large crowds. As
a precaution against untoward incidents, the French
Police despatched additional policemen to patrol the
various streets and to search pedestrians. All Chinese,
European and Annamite policemen, who had gone off duty,
were ordered to stand by.

Upon learning of the above occurrences, the
French Police detailed a large number of detectives and
policemen to maintain peace and sent out armed cars to
patrol the streets. At the same time, the Police
persuaded the shopkeepers to resume business as usual,
but the latter ignored the request.
Yesterday afternoon the Chinese Ratepayers'
Association in the French Concession held an urgent
meeting at which it was resolved that the Chinese
councillors should open negotiations with the French
Consul-General on April 20 and demand the immediate
release of all the persons arrested by the French Police
and the return of all the flags seized. The councillors
should also demand that such Police action should not
be repeated in future.
The "Shun Pao" reports that the French
authorities have promised to release all the persons
arrested and to return all the flags.

People Asked to Wait Calmly for Settlement

The Headquarters of the Shanghai Various
Circles' National Spiritual Mobilization Association
has issued the following manifesto:-
To local residents:
Yesterday (April 19) being the propaganda
day for peasants, workers and commercial circles, the
people in this locality hoisted the national flag as
a sign of their enthusiasm. Unexpectedly, the French
authorities interfered with the hoisting of flags and
arrested several persons and seized many flags. We
regret this unfriendly action. The brave demonstration
held by our brethren is an expression of enthusiasm for the
spiritual mobilization. The various public bodies have
already sent a joint telegram to the Ministry of Foreign
Affairs with a request that negotiations be opened with
the French Ambassador to China. As it is believed that
this incident will be amicably settled, it is earnestly
hoped that the residents will wait calmly and observe
peace and order.*
pages.zh:
1939年4月20日。晨间译件。

西城门路

下午1时，在西城门路（Rue Porte de l'Ouest）靠近市场路（Rue du Marche）的地方也发生了争执，当时几家商店被警察命令降下国旗。维新公司的一名员工被捕。因此，附近其他商店暂停营业。
该事件吸引了大量人群。为预防意外事件，法国警方增派警察巡逻各条街道并搜查行人。所有已下班的中国、欧洲和安南籍警察均被命令待命。

获悉上述情况后，法国警方抽调大量侦探和警察维持治安，并派出武装车辆巡逻街道。同时，警方劝说店主恢复常态营业，但后者无视了这一请求。
昨日下午，法租界华人纳税人在法租界召开紧急会议，决议由华人董事于4月20日与法国总领事展开谈判，要求立即释放所有被法国警方逮捕的人员，并归还所有被没收的旗帜。董事们还应要求今后不再重复此类警察行动。
据《申报》报道，法国当局已承诺释放所有被捕人员并归还所有旗帜。

呼吁民众冷静等待解决

上海各界精神动员协会总部发布如下宣言：-
致本地居民：
昨日（4月19日）是农民、工人和商界宣传日，本地民众悬挂国旗以表达热情。不料，法国当局干涉悬挂国旗，逮捕数人并没收多面旗帜。我们对这种不友好行为表示遗憾。我同胞举行的英勇示威是对精神动员热情的表达。各公共团体已向外交部发送联合电报，请求与中国法国大使展开谈判。鉴于相信此事件将得到和平解决，恳切希望居民们冷静等待，遵守和平与秩序。*

pages.en:
April 20, 1939. Morning Translation.

French Police Issue Proclamation

On April 19 the French authorities issued
the following proclamation:-
"Notice is hereby given that in the French
Concession political demonstrations are strictly
forbidden on the ground that such demonstrations will
lead to disturbances and menace peace and good order and
might have been instigated by bad elements. Apart from
taking the necessary steps, the authorities will maintain
the neutrality of the Concession and will undertake full
responsibility for the protection of the residents. If
necessary, the authorities will expel bad elements.
As regards the collective display of the national
flag, such display has the meaning of a political
demonstration and is prohibited, except in the case of
national celebrations. This notice is again issued
for the information of all residents."

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese owned Chinese language newspaper) :-

Police Action Taken at Request of Shanghai City Government

Yesterday being the propaganda day for the
peasants, workers and commercial circles of the propaganda
week of the national spiritual mobilization, the Chinese
national flag was hoisted by all the shops in the Foreign
Settlements. They were however removed by the Police of
the Foreign Settlements and taken to police stations.
This action was taken by the authorities at the request
of the Shanghai City Government.

Ta Mei Pao and other local newspapers :-

Final Warning Issued by China Youths' Patriotic Salvation
Association

On April 18 identical letters issued by the
so-called "China Youths' Patriotic Salvation Association"
were received by all Chinese language newspapers of
British, American and other foreign ownership.
Yesterday the following final warning addressed
to the 3,000,000 Chinese residents in Shanghai was issued
by the Association:-
"Unless the residents discontinue the hoisting
of the blue sky and white sun flag, bullets and bombs
will be used against those who disregard this warning."
A written copy of this warning was received
by the "Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury" yesterday. It
reads as follows:-
"The national flag is a symbol of a nation.
Following the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese hostilities,
this Association has on several occasions issued warnings
to the residents of the two Foreign Settlements against the
hoisting of the blue sky and white sun flag, but the warnings
were ignored. Therefore a final warning was issued
yesterday urging the residents to come to their senses.
Unless they modify their present attitude, bullets and bombs
will be used against them. The public are hereby warned
not to complain of not having being informed beforehand
if their lives are endangered for hoisting such flags."

1939年4月20日。晨间译件。

法国警方发布公告

4月19日，法国当局发布了以下公告：-
“特此通告，在法租界内严禁政治示威，理由是此类示威会导致骚乱，威胁和平与良好秩序，且可能由不良分子煽动。除了采取必要措施外，当局将维持租界的中立，并承担保护居民的全部责任。如有必要，当局将驱逐不良分子。
至于集体展示国旗，此种展示具有政治示威的含义，除国庆庆典外，一律禁止。特此再次发布本通知，以供所有居民知悉。”

《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）：-

应上海市政府请求采取警察行动

昨日是全国精神动员宣传周中针对农民、工人和商界的宣传日，外国租界内的所有商店均悬挂了中国国旗。然而，这些国旗被外国租界的警察移除并带往警察局。
当局采取这一行动是应上海市政府的请求。

《大美报》及其他本地报纸：-

中国青年救国协会发出最后警告

4月18日，所有英、美及其他外资拥有的中文报纸均收到了所谓“中国青年救国协会”发出的相同信件。
昨日，该协会向上海300万中国居民发出了如下最后警告：-
“除非居民停止悬挂青天白日旗，否则将对无视此警告者使用子弹和炸弹。”
《上海晚邮报与水星报》昨日收到了这份警告的书面副本。内容如下：-
“国旗是一个国家的象征。中日敌对状态爆发后，本协会曾多次向两个外国租界的居民发出警告，反对悬挂青天白日旗，但这些警告被无视。因此，昨日发出最后警告，敦促居民清醒过来。除非他们改变目前的态度，否则将对他们使用子弹和炸弹。特此警告公众，如果因悬挂此类旗帜而危及生命，不得抱怨事先未获告知。”

pages.en:
April 20, 1939.                                      Morning Translation

Hwa Mei Chen Pao (comment) :-

The Action of the French Police in Interfering with the
Hoisting of the National Flag is very unwise

On March 12, the authorities of the French
Concession interfered with the hoisting of the Chinese
national flag in commemoration of the death of Dr. Sun
Yat-sen. After the incident, negotiations were opened
with the Concession authorities by various public bodies
and in addition the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the
National Government was requested to lodge a protest with
the French authorities. At that time, the authorities
of the French Concession stated that this action was taken
because the flags were hoisted at the instigation of the
Tangpu. This is far from being a satisfactory ground
to justify the adoption of such a step by the French
authorities. On March 29, the anniversary of the
death of 72 martyrs in the Canton Uprising, the national
flag was again displayed by the Chinese people, but this
time the French Concession authorities did not interfere.
Yesterday, flags were again hoisted by
the Chinese people in commemoration of the anniversary
of the establishment of the National Government at Nanking,
but they were, however, interfered with by the French
Concession authorities who removed the flags.
Whatever may be the reason for the
French police action, we are of the opinion that its
action is unwise because
(1) A flag is a symbol representing
a nation and those who respect their country should also
show respect to the national flag of a friendly nation.
(2) The flag of a blue sky and white
sun is the flag of the National Government, the only
legitimate government in China recognized by the French
Government which has always been on friendly relations
with the Chinese Government.
(3) In order to preserve peace and
order, the residents should have a proper medium to
demonstrate their feelings.
It is to be feared that the action
of the French Concession authorities in depriving the
residents of the freedom to hoist their national flag
will not conduce towards the maintenance of peace and
order.
M. Henri Cosme, the French Ambassador
to China, has only recently returned from Chungking
after having presented his credentials to the National
Government. We would like to know what he feels in
this controversy.

1939年4月20日。晨间译稿

《华美晨报》（评论）：-

法国警方干涉悬挂国旗之举甚为不智

3月12日，法租界当局干涉了为纪念孙中山博士逝世而悬挂中国国旗的活动。事件发生后，各公共团体与租界当局展开交涉，此外还请求国民政府外交部向法国当局提出抗议。当时，法租界当局称，采取此举是因为悬挂国旗系受“汤浦”（音译）煽动所致。这绝非法国当局采取此类步骤的令人满意的正当理由。3月29日，即广州起义七十二烈士殉难纪念日，中国人民再次展示国旗，但此次法租界当局并未加以干涉。昨日，中国人民再次悬挂国旗以纪念南京国民政府成立周年，然而却遭到法租界当局的干涉，旗帜被移除。
无论法国警方行动的理由为何，我们认为其行动是不明智的，因为
(1) 国旗是代表一个国家的象征，尊重自己国家的人也应当对友好国家的国旗表示尊重。
(2) 青天白日旗是国民政府的旗帜，而法国政府始终与中国政府保持友好关系，并承认国民政府为中国唯一合法政府。
(3) 为了维持和平与秩序，居民应当拥有表达情感的适当途径。
恐怕法租界当局剥夺居民悬挂本国国旗自由的做法，将无助于维持和平与秩序。
法国驻华大使亨利·科斯梅（Henri Cosme）先生近期在向国民政府递交国书后刚从重庆返回。我们想知道他对这一争议有何看法。

April 20, 1939.
Morning Translation.

Shun Pao (Editorial) 8-

Prohibition due to Misunderstanding

Yesterday being the propaganda day of farmers,
labourers and merchants of the propaganda week for the
national spiritual mobilization, Chinese residents in the
two Foreign Settlements hoisted the national flag to
display their spirit. Unexpectedly, clashes took place
in the French Concession between policemen and the
residents over the hoisting of the national flag.
Fearing that the affair may spread, the French authorities
returned the flags to the Chinese residents and released
the arrested persons. Chinese residents in the French
Concession are highly indignant and many shops closed
their doors.

The authorities of the French Concession and
the residents have always been on friendly terms.
On the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese hostilities, the
French authorities observed strict neutrality in maintaining
peace and good order in the French Concession. The
Chinese residents were very pleased with the attitude
of the French authorities. Minor disputes arose sometime
ago in the French Concession wherein the hoisting of the
Chinese national flag was interfered with. A similar
case has now arisen. We are of the opinion that all
this must have been due to some misunderstanding.

A flag represents a nation and the people
have the freedom of hoisting their national flag.
Friendly nations should not interfere with the hoisting
of the national flag. Although the Foreign Settlements
of Shanghai are special areas, they are still part of
China's territory, and the people of China have the
right to hoist their national flag as foreign nationals
have. The intelligent French authorities should
realize this. It is possible that because of the
existence of "special circumstances", the French
authorities have adopted their present policy in order
to maintain peace and order in the Concession, but we
do not believe this is the case.

As special friendly relations exist between
China and France, it is only natural for the French
authorities to recognize the National Government of China
as the only legal government of China. The French
authorities should not interfere with the hoisting of
the national flag, thereby harming the diplomatic
relations between China and France. If the French
authorities hesitate because of the influence of a special
party, then the hereditary spirit of chivalry and freedom
of the French people will be lost. Why do not the
authorities of the French Concession observe the policy
of their Government and treat the residents in the
French Concession according to this policy?

It is probable that on account of the prevalence
of terroristic acts, the French authorities interfered
with the hoisting of the Chinese flag to avoid untoward
incidents. The Chinese national flag was flown in the
International Settlement yesterday, but nothing occurred

《申报》（社论）8-

因误解而禁止

昨日正值国民精神总动员宣传周中农、工、商的宣传日，两租界内的中国居民悬挂国旗以彰显其精神。不料，法租界内警察与居民因悬挂国旗一事发生冲突。法方当局担心事态蔓延，遂将国旗归还中国居民，并释放了被捕人员。法租界内的中国居民极为愤慨，许多商店闭门停业。

法租界当局与居民一向和睦相处。中日战事爆发之际，法国当局为维持法租界内的和平与良好秩序，恪守严格中立。中国居民对法国当局的态度深感满意。不久前，法租界内曾发生一些小纠纷，其中涉及干涉悬挂中国国旗之事。如今类似案件再次发生。我们认为，这一切必定是由于某种误解所致。

国旗代表一个国家，人民拥有悬挂本国国旗的自由。友好国家不应干涉悬挂国旗的行为。虽然上海的外国租界是特殊区域，但它们仍是中国领土的一部分，中国人民如同外国国民一样，有权悬挂本国国旗。明智的法国当局应认识到这一点。或许由于存在“特殊情况”，法国当局为维护租界内的和平与秩序而采取了目前的政策，但我们不相信情况属实。

鉴于中法之间存在特殊的友好关系，法国当局承认中国国民政府为中国唯一合法政府，乃是理所当然之事。法国当局不应干涉悬挂国旗，从而损害中法之间的外交关系。如果法国当局因受某一特殊党派的影响而犹豫不决，那么法国人民世袭的侠义与自由精神将会丧失。法租界当局为何不遵循其政府的政策，并据此对待法租界内的居民？

很可能由于恐怖活动盛行，法国当局为避免不幸事件发生而干涉悬挂中国国旗。昨日，公共租界内悬挂了中国国旗，但未发生任何

April 20, 1939.
Morning Translation.

to distu) the peace. The French authorities should
have issued a notice beforehand explaining the reasons
why the national flag should not be hoisted. In that
way, no misunderstanding would have occurred, but the
French authorities had failed to notify residents of
the prohibition. The Chinese residents hoisted the
national flag on the propaganda day of the national
spiritual mobilization to express their enthusiasm.
The hoisting of the flag does not violate the Police
regulations of the Concession. Yet the French Police
forcibly ordered the taking down of the national flag
and rough handling could not be avoided. The residents
cannot help being indignant over the affair.
A serious incident took place last year
when the authorities of the International Settlement
stopped the "Lone Battalion" from displaying the national
flag. The Chinese people living in this isolated island
are imbued with the spirit of the "Lone Battalion"; they
are prepared to shed their blood for the sake of their
flag. It is lucky that the residents in the French
Concession were able to subdue their indignation yesterday
and only small trouble took place. We hope that the
intelligent authorities of the French Concession will
give careful consideration to the flag affair.
On the other hand, we have to advise Chinese
residents in the Foreign Settlements that they should
be patient. We must refrain from creating serious
incidents through misunderstanding. Legal bodies in
Shanghai should lodge a protest with the authorities of
the French Concession and should immediately request the
National Government to lodge a protest with the French
Government through diplomatic channels and to demand
that similar incidents will not occur again.
Unnecessary strife and rumoured strikes
should be avoided. We should wait calmly for a settlement.

扰乱和平之事。法国当局本应事先发布通告，解释为何不应悬挂国旗。如此一来，便不会发生误解，但法国当局未能通知居民此项禁令。中国居民在国民精神总动员宣传日悬挂国旗，以表达其热情。悬挂国旗并不违反租界的警务规章。然而，法国警察强行命令降下国旗，且难免出现粗暴行为。居民对此事不禁感到愤慨。
去年曾发生一起严重事件，当时公共租界当局阻止“孤军”展示国旗。生活在这座孤岛上的中国人民深受“孤军”精神的感召；他们准备为他们的旗帜流血牺牲。幸运的是，法租界居民昨日能够抑制愤怒，仅发生了小规模骚乱。我们希望明智的法租界当局能慎重考虑国旗事件。
另一方面，我们必须劝告外侨居住区内的中国居民保持耐心。我们必须避免因误解而制造严重事件。上海的合法团体应向法租界当局提出抗议，并应立即请求国民政府通过外交渠道向法国政府提出抗议，要求不得再发生类似事件。
应避免不必要的争斗和谣传的罢工。我们应冷静等待解决。
